title: DUALTRON VICTOR 60V 24Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Victor 2025 60V 24Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Victor 2025 represents a refined evolution of one of Minimotors’ most balanced and versatile models. Now equipped with a 60V 24Ah battery and dual 4000W hub motors, it combines everyday practicality with serious performance. The addition of the upgraded EY3 throttle and new controller enhances both control precision and customization, making the Victor 2025 a dependable choice for riders who value agility, range, and responsive handling.

Power and Performance

The Victor 2025 features dual 2000W hub motors for a combined peak output of 4000W. It reaches a top speed of 80 km/h while maintaining strong torque for quick acceleration and hill climbs. The 60V controller delivers consistent energy flow, ensuring smooth, controlled power at every speed. The result is a ride that balances strength and efficiency, ideal for both city commutes and weekend rides.

Battery and Range

Equipped with a 60V 24Ah battery using CHINA 21700 cells, the Victor 2025 offers up to 70 km of range on a single charge. Its 1.5 kWh capacity ensures stable voltage output throughout the discharge cycle, supporting longer rides without performance loss. The system is optimized for reliability and minimal temperature drift, ideal for riders who demand consistency in every trip.

New EY3 Display and Connectivity

The upgraded EY3 throttle includes Bluetooth connectivity and integration with the Minimotors App. Riders can track speed, battery level, and trip statistics, as well as adjust settings like acceleration response and regenerative braking strength. The display is brighter and more durable, with improved visibility under sunlight, giving riders complete command over their performance setup.

Chassis and Build Quality

The Dualtron Victor 2025 retains the rugged aluminum-alloy frame and compact folding system that made the original a favorite among riders. At 33 kg, it remains portable yet solidly built, capable of supporting a 100 kg rider without compromising stability. The wide deck and balanced geometry ensure excellent control at both low and high speeds.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

The adjustable rubber cartridge suspension provides a comfortable ride across urban surfaces and uneven terrain. Riders can tune the suspension stiffness to match their weight or riding style. Combined with durable 10-inch pneumatic tires, the setup delivers superior traction, cushioning, and confidence on longer journeys.

Braking and Safety

Dual disc brakes with electronic assistance deliver sharp, consistent braking performance. The brake levers provide firm, progressive feedback, improving rider confidence during high-speed riding. Regenerative braking adds energy recovery and smooth deceleration, reducing mechanical wear and extending battery life.

Design and Servicing Improvements

The 2025 Victor introduces several refinements for easier maintenance. The new rear mudguard design features externally mounted screws for quick access to the rear wheel, simplifying tire and brake servicing. The clean cable layout and sealed electronic compartment improve durability and water resistance during daily use.

Lighting and Visibility

Integrated LED headlight, taillight, and deck lights improve night visibility and enhance safety. The bright front beam ensures reliable illumination for low-light conditions, while rear indicators and reflectors keep the rider visible from all sides.

Controller and Electrical Enhancements

The updated controller offers better heat management and increased reliability under load. It enables finer control over acceleration curves, improving responsiveness without compromising battery efficiency. Electrical insulation has been upgraded to minimize interference and moisture exposure.

Portability and Everyday Usability

The Victor 2025 folds compactly for transport and storage, fitting easily into car boots or under desks. The latch mechanism is reinforced for smoother operation and improved long-term strength. With its lightweight build and powerful output, the Victor remains one of the most versatile scooters in the Dualtron lineup.

In the Box

Included: standard charger, power cable, nut caps, multi-tool kit, and user manual. Optional fast charger, seat post, or extended deck mat available separately.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Victor 2025 60V 24Ah delivers the perfect balance of range, speed, and control. With its new EY3 throttle, improved controller, and service-friendly design, it refines the proven Victor platform into a faster, smarter, and more reliable electric scooter. Built for riders seeking compact power and precise handling, the Victor 2025 continues Dualtron’s legacy of performance and innovation.

title: DUALTRON NEW VICTOR 60V 24AH
body_html:
Dualtron New Victor 60V 24Ah

The Dualtron New Victor 60V 24Ah refines the proven Victor platform with balanced performance, improved components, and everyday usability. Powered by a 60V system with a 24Ah (1.4 kWh) CHINA 21700 battery, it delivers efficient energy output and reliable range. The dual hub motors produce a combined 4000W, reaching speeds up to 80 km/h (50 mph). With a maximum range of 70 km (45 mi) and a 100 kg rider capacity, it offers a strong mix of power, control, and portability.

Power and Battery System

The 1.4 kWh lithium battery ensures stable voltage delivery and efficient current flow to both motors, supporting smooth acceleration and consistent range. The dual 2000W BLDC motors provide strong torque and responsive power delivery, making the scooter suitable for both urban commuting and higher-speed riding.

Display and Connectivity

The 3rd generation EY4 display features a modern interface with Bluetooth connectivity. When paired with the Minimotors App, riders can monitor performance data, adjust riding parameters, and enable security features such as PIN lock and system control.

Design and Build

Constructed from high-grade aluminum alloy, the frame balances durability and weight, keeping the scooter at 33 kg. The compact structure improves handling and transport, while the 3rd generation kickstand offers enhanced stability when parked.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

Dual rubber cartridge suspension absorbs shocks and allows adjustment for rider preference. Combined with puncture-resistant tubeless tires, the setup improves grip, reduces maintenance, and maintains stability across varied terrain.

Braking System

The upgraded XD H880 braking system provides strong and consistent stopping power with improved control. It ensures reliable performance during high-speed braking and repeated use, enhancing overall safety.

Lighting and Visibility

Integrated LED lighting improves visibility in low-light conditions. Front, rear, and deck lights ensure the rider remains visible in urban environments while maintaining efficient power consumption.

Handling and Control

The low center of gravity and stable deck geometry provide precise handling and rider confidence. Wide handlebars improve control during acceleration, braking, and cornering, ensuring a balanced riding experience.

In the Box

Included: standard charger, power cable, user manual, multi-tool, and nut caps. Optional accessories include a fast charger and seat kit.

Conclusion

The Dualtron New Victor 60V 24Ah delivers a refined combination of power, range, and upgraded components. With dual motors, EY4 display integration, improved brakes, and tubeless tires, it provides a reliable and efficient ride suited for both daily use and performance riding.

title: DUALTRON POP SINGLE MOTOR 52V 14Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Pop 2025 Single Motor 52V 14Ah

The Dualtron Pop 2025 Single Motor 52V 14Ah delivers practical speed, range, and durability in a lightweight, compact design. Powered by a 52V 14Ah CHINA 21700 battery pack, it drives a single BLDC hub motor with a 1360W peak output. This setup achieves speeds up to 55 km/h (35 mph) with a range of 40 km (25 mi) per charge. Weighing only 30 kg and supporting up to 90 kg rider weight, it offers excellent balance between performance and portability for daily city commuting or leisure rides.

Battery and Motor

The 0.7 kWh battery delivers steady voltage output across its charge cycle, maximizing efficiency and reducing power loss during acceleration. The 52V system supplies ample torque for confident starts and uphill climbs, while the single hub motor minimizes maintenance requirements compared to dual-drive systems.

Frame and Construction

Built from reinforced aluminum alloy, the frame maintains rigidity and impact resistance while keeping the overall structure lightweight. A silicone-covered deck enhances traction and reduces vibration, offering secure footing and comfort during long rides. Compact geometry makes the Pop easy to store and transport.

Suspension and Tires

The front and rear rubber suspension system provides shock absorption over uneven surfaces, improving ride stability and comfort. Equipped with 9-inch tubeless tires, the scooter ensures good traction and lower risk of punctures, suitable for mixed urban terrain.

Braking System

Front and rear drum brakes deliver consistent mechanical braking, complemented by an electronic braking system (EBS) for smooth deceleration. This dual setup increases rider confidence by improving braking balance and response time.

Lighting and Safety

Integrated LED headlights, rear tail lights, and reflective side markers ensure strong visibility in both day and night conditions. The IPX5-rated components protect against light rain and splashes, extending lifespan and reliability.

Display and Controls

The EY3 digital throttle display shows real-time speed, battery level, and trip data. Connected via the Dualtron App, riders can customize acceleration curves, lights, and system diagnostics. The waterproof connectors and control wiring enhance durability and maintain performance under varied conditions.

Folding and Portability

The reinforced folding mechanism includes heavy-duty locking pins and a dual-clamp design for extra rigidity. Foldable handlebars make storage simple, whether in small flats, car boots, or office spaces. The 30 kg total weight keeps transport manageable without compromising structural integrity.

Durability and Maintenance

With upgraded internal cabling, sealed charging ports, and reinforced motor mounts, the Pop 2025 is built for long-term use with minimal upkeep. The IPX5 water resistance rating ensures electrical components remain protected against rain and road spray.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Pop 2025 Single Motor 52V 14Ah offers 35 mph top speed, 25 mi range, and smooth performance in a portable, sturdy frame. With its efficient power delivery, durable build, and accessible weight, it’s an excellent choice for riders who want reliable, everyday mobility with true Dualtron quality.

Ride Comfort and Handling

title: DUALTRON NEW VICTOR LUXURY PLUS 60V 28AH
body_html:
Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus 2025 60V 28Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus 2025 represents the next evolution in the Victor lineup, combining refined design, superior build quality, and advanced performance technology. Powered by dual 4300W hub motors and a 60V 28Ah CHINA 21700 battery, it delivers dynamic acceleration, stable handling, and extended range all integrated with the new EY4 display and app connectivity system.

Power and Performance

With dual BLDC hub motors producing a total of 4300W peak output, the Victor Luxury Plus offers powerful acceleration and a top speed of up to 85 km/h. The 60V system provides consistent torque delivery, ensuring confident performance across varying terrain. Smooth throttle control and responsive torque management make it suitable for both urban cruising and longer-distance travel.

Battery and Range

The 60V 28Ah CHINA 21700 battery provides up to 85 km of range per charge, balancing efficiency with high output. Its 1.7 kWh energy capacity ensures steady voltage and minimal power drop-off during heavy use. Dual charging ports allow faster recharging with compatible chargers, while built-in battery management safeguards against overcharging, overheating, and deep discharge.

title: DUALTRON SONIC MODEL A ALIEN 72V 40Ah WHITE
body_html:

The Dualtron Sonic Alien 72V 40Ah is a flagship high-performance electric scooter engineered for extreme power, advanced electronic control systems, and modular serviceability. A next-generation controller delivers DC110A in normal mode and DC140A in turbo mode, providing high power density with improved protection and cleaner wiring.

A patented active motor cooling system actively manages motor temperature to maintain consistent output and enhance long-term durability. The modular front and rear wheel design allows the tyre and hub to be removed separately, while motor connectors are housed inside the swing arms for easier maintenance and cleaner cable routing.

Braking performance is handled by NUTT 4-piston hydraulic brakes with 160 mm discs, supported by ABS + EBS + CBS combined braking systems. The linked braking configuration distributes braking force intelligently for improved stability during emergency stops. An adjustable hydraulic steering damper is fitted as standard to enhance high-speed control.

The suspension system features a fully mechanical front and rear setup with interchangeable leaf-spring cartridges and adjustable gaskets, engineered to balance comfort, durability, and temperature isolation across varied riding conditions.

Lighting and visibility are comprehensive, featuring a 45W automatic front headlight, sequential front and rear turn signals, rear tail light, reflectors, and RGB ambient lighting integrated into the stem and body. Ambient lighting is fully app-controlled, allowing customization of color, lighting mode, animation speed, and on/off control.

Smart systems include a TFT color display (EYA) with automatic brightness adjustment via an ambient light sensor, built-in GPS, Bluetooth app connectivity, anti-theft alarm, horn, electric brake signal, voltmeter control, and an integrated Battery Management System (BMS). Additional safety systems include traction control (TCS) and an AVAS acoustic alert system.

Equipped with 11-inch run-flat tyres, a two-wheel-drive system, and a reinforced forged frame, the Dualtron Sonic Alien is designed for riders who demand maximum performance, advanced technology, and long-term serviceability in a single platform.

Key Specifications

  • Battery: 72V 40Ah (Samsung 21700 50S 9C or LG INR21700H51T 9C)
  • Motors: Dual BLDC hub motors, 2500W ×2
  • Controller: DC110A (Normal Mode) / DC140A (Turbo Mode)
  • Drive System: Two-wheel drive
  • Maximum Speed: Approx. 110 km/h
  • Range: Approx. 125 km (at 25 km/h, 75 kg load)
  • Tyres: 11-inch run-flat tyres
  • Brakes: NUTT 4-piston hydraulic brakes, 160 mm discs, ABS + EBS + CBS
  • Suspension: Front & rear mechanical suspension with interchangeable cartridges
  • Lighting: 45W automatic front headlight, RGB ambient lighting, sequential indicators
  • Display: TFT color display (EYA) with ambient light sensor
  • Net Weight: Approx. 53.5 kg
  • Maximum Load: 120 kg
  • Seat: Optional accessory (sold separately)

Performance figures are based on controlled laboratory testing. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, terrain, temperature, and riding style.

The sturdy aluminum chassis supports up to 100 kg, ensuring stability without excessive weight. At 30 kg, it strikes a fine balance between strength and portability.

Lighting and Waterproofing

The integrated lighting system, E-mark certified, includes a forward headlight, rear tail lights, turn indicators, and side reflectors. Rated at IPX5 waterproof protection, the scooter withstands splashes and light rain. Its silicone deck grip enhances safety and control while providing water-resistant footing.

Handling and Comfort

The combination of a low center of gravity, wide handlebar control, and dual suspension makes the Aminia agile yet secure. The dual-motor setup distributes power smoothly across both wheels, enhancing grip and cornering stability. Riders experience confidence at top speeds without losing comfort during long rides.

Design and Features

The Aminia Long Body includes an upgraded folding mechanism for fast, secure collapsibility and a top-mounted charging port for convenience. The silicone deck grip, enclosed cabling, and compact motor housings reduce wear from vibration and environmental exposure. Every element emphasizes reliability and everyday usability.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Aminia Long Body Dual Motor 2025 delivers premium performance in a compact 52V platform. With dual 450W motors (1800W peak), 15.6Ah 21700 battery cells, 60 km/h top speed, 40 km range, IPX5 waterproof rating, and a sturdy 30 kg build, it redefines what a small-frame Dualtron can achieve combining urban agility with long-distance endurance in a refined, practical design.

title: DUALTRON MINI SPECIAL LONG BODY SINGLE MOTOR 52V 10Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 10Ah

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor delivers reliable performance in a sleek, compact frame. Powered by a 52V 10Ah lithium battery using CHINA 2000 cells, it produces 900W of motor output for efficient acceleration and stable cruising. Capable of reaching 55 km/h (35 mph) with a range of 30 km (20 mi), it’s built for riders who need strong single-motor performance in a portable form factor.

Battery and Power System

The 52V system paired with a 10Ah pack offers 0.5 kWh of energy storage. This provides consistent torque and efficient energy use, making the Mini ideal for urban rides and light off-road paths. The setup maintains steady power output even under full load and hill climbs. The scooter supports riders up to 90 kg and weighs only 30 kg, ensuring easy transport and handling without sacrificing performance.

Design and Construction

The Long Body edition includes an extended deck for improved foot placement and balance. A silicone non-slip coating replaces traditional grip tape, reducing wear while simplifying cleaning and maintenance. The sturdy aluminum alloy frame ensures rigidity and ride comfort, combining strength with a lightweight build suitable for daily use.

Ride Comfort and Handling

Equipped with a front and rear spring-rubber suspension system, the Dualtron Mini 2025 absorbs vibration effectively over uneven terrain. The 9-inch hybrid tires enhance grip and reduce rolling resistance, offering control and smoothness whether on pavement or compact ground.

Safety and Braking

The scooter uses a reliable drum brake setup on both wheels for balanced stopping performance. Electronic braking assists in energy recovery and enhances control during downhill rides or emergency stops. This system offers predictable braking with minimal maintenance requirements.

Lighting and Visibility

Integrated headlights and taillights ensure visibility in all conditions. Reflectors on both suspension arms increase nighttime safety, while the beam angle can be adjusted to improve forward visibility without dazzling oncoming riders or pedestrians.

Folding and Portability

The reinforced folding column with dual-locking design allows quick folding without play in the steering column. Foldable handlebars make transport simple, while the scooter’s 30 kg total weight keeps it manageable for everyday mobility or storage in limited spaces.

Controls and Connectivity

The EY3 throttle with LCD display provides real-time readouts of speed, voltage, trip distance, and battery level. Paired with the Dualtron App via Bluetooth, riders can monitor diagnostics, adjust acceleration response, and control lighting modes. The interface is water-resistant for use in varied conditions.

Build Durability

The IPX5-rated structure protects internal electronics from moisture and dust, while the insulated charging port prevents arcing and corrosion. Combined with a silicone-coated deck and protected wiring layout, the Mini 2025 is engineered for reliability through daily use.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 10Ah combines a 900W motor, 55 km/h top speed, and 30 km range in a robust yet compact design. With efficient suspension, dependable brakes, and Bluetooth-enabled controls, it offers the perfect balance of performance and practicality for riders seeking a lightweight, high-quality electric scooter.

title: DUALTRON MINI SPECIAL LONG BODY SINGLE MOTOR 52V 17.5Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 17.5Ah

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 17.5Ah is engineered for riders seeking reliability, range, and compact design in one balanced package. Powered by a 52V 17.5Ah battery using LG-MJ1-3500 cells, it delivers 900W of continuous output and up to 1450W peak power. With a top speed of 55 km/h (35 mph) and a range of 50 km (30 mi), it offers efficient performance for daily commuting or leisure rides while maintaining a manageable 30 kg frame.

Performance and Power System

The single BLDC hub motor provides smooth torque and responsive acceleration, optimized through an efficient controller setup. The 0.9 kWh lithium battery ensures consistent voltage delivery and long-term stability, while the 52V system provides improved efficiency across gradients and longer distances. Its maximum rider load of 90 kg suits a wide variety of users.

Design and Construction

The Long Body frame uses reinforced aluminum for strength and stability. The extended deck offers more foot space, improving comfort and control during high-speed rides. A silicone anti-slip deck surface enhances grip, simplifies cleaning, and increases durability compared to traditional grip tape finishes.

Ride Comfort and Suspension

Equipped with dual suspension featuring front and rear spring-rubber modules, the scooter absorbs shocks effectively on uneven terrain. Combined with 9-inch hybrid tubeless tires, it provides reliable traction and a stable ride across city roads or light off-road surfaces.

Braking and Control

Front and rear drum brakes deliver consistent braking performance, supported by an electronic braking system for added safety and energy recovery. The setup is tuned for predictable response and low maintenance while maintaining effective stopping power under different conditions.

Lighting and Visibility

The integrated LED headlight and rear brake light provide clear illumination for night rides. Side reflectors enhance lateral visibility. The headlight angle is adjustable to reduce glare and improve focus on the riding path ahead.

Interface and Connectivity

The EY3 digital display presents real-time data on speed, voltage, and mileage. Bluetooth connectivity allows pairing with the Dualtron App, giving access to settings, diagnostics, and firmware updates. The display and throttle system are IPX5 water-resistant, suitable for daily outdoor use.

Folding and Portability

The Mini 2025’s upgraded folding mechanism includes reinforced locking pins and a solid hinge system to eliminate play at high speeds. Foldable handlebars make transport and storage simple, while the 30 kg total weight keeps it manageable for carrying or vehicle loading.

Durability and Protection

The scooter’s electronics and connectors are IPX5-rated, ensuring resistance to rain and dust. The improved charging port includes insulated protection against moisture and corrosion. Cable routing is optimized for longevity and ease of maintenance.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 17.5Ah combines 900W of efficient power, 55 km/h top speed, and 50 km range in a sturdy and portable frame. It’s a dependable, feature-rich option for riders who need a compact yet powerful scooter capable of handling daily commutes and extended weekend rides.

title: DUALTRON MINI SPECIAL LONG BODY SINGLE MOTOR 52V 21Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 21Ah

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 21Ah is a refined balance of power, endurance, and portability. It’s equipped with a 52V 21Ah LG-MJ1-3500 battery and a 900W motor delivering up to 1450W peak output, achieving a top speed of 55 km/h (35 mph). With a range of up to 65 km (40 mi), it’s designed for riders who demand extended range without added bulk. Supporting up to 90 kg, the Mini 2025 remains agile and efficient at just 30 kg total weight.

Battery and Powertrain

The 52V electrical system ensures steady torque and smooth acceleration. The 1.1 kWh LG-MJ1 battery provides consistent voltage and high energy density, extending battery life and improving ride efficiency. Its single hub BLDC motor is tuned for responsive control and steady speed even under load, ideal for both commuting and light recreational use.

Build and Frame Design

The Long Body frame extends deck length for improved balance and riding stance. Constructed from high-grade aluminum alloy, it combines strength and low weight. The silicone deck covering enhances grip, reduces vibration, and is resistant to wear and moisture, maintaining a clean look over time.

Ride Comfort and Handling

Dual suspension with steel spring and rubber damping units absorb shocks on urban roads and uneven terrain. The 9-inch tubeless tires improve traction, comfort, and puncture resistance, giving stable handling even at higher speeds. The wider wheelbase further enhances stability and maneuverability.

Braking and Safety

The front and rear drum brakes provide reliable braking force, while the electronic braking system supports smooth deceleration and regenerative energy recovery. The braking setup ensures predictable control across dry and wet conditions for safe urban navigation.

Lighting and Visibility

Front and rear LED lights improve visibility, and reflectors positioned on suspension arms increase lateral safety at night. The headlight beam can be adjusted for better road illumination while minimizing glare for pedestrians or traffic.

Display and Controls

The EY3 display provides key metrics like speed, mileage, and voltage in real time. Through Bluetooth, riders can connect to the Dualtron App to adjust ride modes, monitor battery health, and update firmware. The system is IPX5-rated, ensuring reliable operation in light rain or humid conditions.

Folding System and Portability

The reinforced folding mechanism features a tighter locking hinge and thicker steering column for added rigidity. Foldable handlebars allow the Mini 2025 to fit in car boots or narrow spaces, and the 30 kg total weight makes it practical for everyday mobility.

Durability and Maintenance

Improved cable routing, moisture-resistant connectors, and an insulated charging port enhance long-term durability. The IPX5 protection rating safeguards electronics from light rain and dust, while modular deck panels simplify access to internal components for servicing.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 21Ah combines extended range, efficient performance, and robust design. Its LG battery, 900W motor, and upgraded comfort features make it a capable all-rounder for commuters and enthusiasts seeking a portable, long-range electric scooter.

title: DUALTRON MINI SPECIAL LONG BODY DUAL MOTOR 52V 21Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Dual Motor 52V 21Ah

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Dual Motor delivers strong dual-motor performance in a compact, portable frame. Running on a 52V system and powered by a 21Ah LG-MJ1-3500 battery, it produces a total output of 1800W and reaches speeds up to 55 km/h (35 mph). With an extended range of 65 km (40 mi) and a low 30 kg weight, it’s ideal for urban riders seeking durability, comfort, and smooth power delivery.

Power and Battery

The 52V 21Ah LG-MJ1-3500 battery provides 1.1 kWh of stored energy, ensuring steady discharge and consistent torque under load. Dual BLDC hub motors generate a combined 1800W nominal power, delivering fast acceleration with low vibration and precise throttle response. Maximum rider load is 90 kg, maintaining efficient performance even on inclines or uneven terrain.

Structural Improvements for 2025

Reinforced Folding System

The 2025 model introduces a thicker, more rigid folding column with improved locking pins and alignment tolerance. This strengthens the steering tube and reduces wobble at higher speeds while extending mechanical lifespan under frequent folding use.

Extended Deck and Silicone Surface

The Long Body variant features a 5 cm longer deck coated with a non-slip silicone surface. The red and white Dualtron Mini logo enhances grip, durability, and maintenance convenience. The silicone design resists wear and improves comfort underfoot on longer rides.

Steel Spring Suspension

Front and rear suspension use steel springs with a PU rubber core. Riders can select among five stiffness levels, allowing adjustments between comfort and responsiveness depending on terrain conditions.

Improved Cable Protection

New plastic twist cable wraps replace neoprene, providing higher resistance against friction and bending. The organized cable path simplifies maintenance and extends lifespan of handlebar wiring.

Performance and Ride Quality

Two 900W motors supply linear power across the entire speed range. Enhanced controllers balance output between both wheels, ensuring traction and efficiency. The setup enables smooth handling during climbs and stable high-speed cruising. Despite the compact frame, the Mini 2025 maintains a solid power-to-weight ratio unmatched in its category.

Safety and Braking

The Dualtron Mini 2025 uses front and rear drum brakes with electronic ABS for improved traction and control. The brake system prevents wheel lock and shortens stopping distance, especially in wet or sloped environments. Combined with balanced weight distribution, braking remains predictable and firm.

Lighting and Visibility

Equipped with a built-in headlight and horn assembly on the handlebar, the Mini 2025 ensures visibility and convenience. The beam angle can be adjusted to prevent glare for oncoming traffic. Reflectors on the front suspension arms and rear swing arms improve nighttime visibility from multiple directions.

Upgraded Components and Design

Split Rim Tires

Both front and rear 9-inch hybrid tires now use identical split rims, simplifying tire replacement and improving serviceability. The hybrid compound enhances traction and puncture resistance for everyday city use.

Insulated Charging Port

The charging interface includes insulation around the connector pins to prevent arcing and corrosion. The port cover shields against moisture and debris, increasing charging safety and durability.

RGB Lighting and App Control

A 16-bit RGB lighting system supports 16 million colors controlled through the Minimotors app via Bluetooth. Users can store light profiles, change brightness, and synchronize effects for improved visibility and personalization.

Controls and Connectivity

The EY3 display with IPX6 protection connects directly to the Minimotors app for real-time diagnostics, temperature data, and light management. Riders can select up to five speed levels, monitor voltage, and track ride statistics. The new throttle offers better screen clarity and faster response to input adjustments.

Comfort and Build

Weighing only 30 kg, the scooter folds compactly for storage or transport. Foldable handlebars improve portability, while the reinforced kickstand provides stability when parked. The longer deck and tuned suspension allow extended riding comfort for commutes or leisure rides alike.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Dual Motor 52V 21Ah merges compact design with serious dual-motor performance. It achieves 55 km/h top speed, 65 km range, and high durability through structural and mechanical upgrades. With EY3 connectivity, adjustable suspension, and refined build quality, it delivers advanced technology and practical power for riders demanding a compact yet capable electric scooter.

Performance and Range

With a top speed of 55 km/h and a maximum range of 35 km, the Mini Dual Motor offers spirited performance in a compact package. Equipped with a front and rear spring-rubber suspension system, the Dualtron Mini absorbs road vibration efficiently. The combination of solid rear and pneumatic front tires enhances grip while reducing maintenance, providing smooth traction on both city and suburban roads.

Braking and Safety

Delivering 1800W of power, a 55 km/h top speed, and 35 km range, the Dualtron Mini 2025 Dual Motor 52V 12Ah blends compact form with strong dual-motor performance. Lightweight, water-resistant, and feature-rich, it stands as the ideal choice for riders who want reliable power and everyday portability in a modern electric scooter.

title: ROVORON R7 60V 42.4Ah (BLACK)
body_html:
The Rovoron R7 is a high-performance dual-motor electric scooter designed for riders who want long range, strong acceleration and everyday comfort. Built around a reinforced integrated frame structure, the R7 combines durability, stability and modern styling with practical features for commuting and recreational riding.

Power comes from dual 900W brushless hub motors controlled by a 60V 50A dual-controller system (25A x 2), delivering smooth acceleration, strong hill-climbing ability and a top speed of up to 65km/h (40mph). Dual charging ports allow faster charging when used with multiple chargers.

A custom-tuned front and rear spring suspension system helps absorb road imperfections while maintaining stability at speed. Combined with large 90/65-6.5 tubeless tyres, the R7 delivers a comfortable and controlled ride on both urban roads and longer journeys.

Braking performance is provided by front and rear disc brakes supported by ABS and EBS electronic braking systems. The aluminium-mounted dual controllers improve heat dissipation and help maintain consistent performance during demanding riding conditions.

The R7 features the latest EY3 smart display with Dualtron App compatibility, allowing riders to monitor speed, battery status and riding information while accessing advanced scooter settings. The ergonomic handlebar layout keeps controls within easy reach for a comfortable riding experience.

Designed with practicality in mind, the scooter includes a forged aluminium folding mechanism, foldable stem and optional folding handlebar system for easier transport and storage. Despite its substantial performance capabilities, the folding design allows the scooter to be stored more conveniently when not in use.

Safety and visibility are enhanced through a comprehensive lighting package that includes a bright front headlight, integrated horn, front and rear turn signals, hazard warning lights, tail light, reflectors and RGB stem lighting. Additional features include a smoke detection system, licence plate holder, rear carrying handle and optional seat compatibility.

Supporting riders up to 120kg, the Rovoron R7 weighs approximately 49kg and measures 1283 x 606 x 1400mm unfolded. Folded dimensions are 1283 x 331 x 606mm, making it more compact for transport and storage.

Combining Samsung battery technology, dual-motor performance, advanced suspension, smart connectivity and a reinforced integrated chassis, the Rovoron R7 is a capable long-range electric scooter built for comfort, reliability and everyday riding enjoyment.

title: DUALTRON NEW VICTOR LUXURY PLUS 60V 31.5Ah
body_html:
Dualtron New Victor Luxury Plus 60V 31.5Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron New Victor Luxury Plus 60V 31.5Ah is a high-performance dual motor electric scooter built for strong acceleration, long-distance riding, and stable control. Powered by a 60V 31.5Ah battery using China 4500 cells, it stores around 1.9 kWh of energy. This battery system drives dual hub motors with a combined output of 4300W, delivering strong torque and a top speed of up to 85 km/h (50 mph). With a scooter weight of 35 kg and a rider weight limit of 100 kg, it offers a strong balance between power, range, and manageable handling.

Performance and Power

The 60V electrical system gives the Victor Luxury Plus efficient power delivery across its dual 4300W hub motor setup. The motors provide fast acceleration, strong hill-climbing ability, and smooth throttle response for both city riding and open-road use. Power is delivered to both wheels for improved traction, helping the scooter stay stable during launch, cornering, and higher-speed riding. The setup is designed to give consistent performance without feeling uncontrolled or difficult to manage.

Battery and Range

The 60V 31.5Ah battery is built with China 4500 cells and provides a total capacity of around 1.9 kWh. This gives the scooter a rated range of up to 95 km, or around 60 miles, depending on rider weight, speed, terrain, tyre pressure, and riding mode. The battery system is designed to maintain steady output under load, while the internal protection system helps manage current, temperature, and discharge safety. This makes the scooter suitable for daily commuting, longer rides, and mixed urban use.

Design and Build Quality

The Victor Luxury Plus uses a strong aluminium frame designed to handle the demands of a 4300W dual motor scooter. At 35 kg, it remains lighter than many larger performance scooters while still offering a stable and planted ride. The reinforced folding structure, wide deck, and balanced frame geometry help reduce flex and improve control at higher speeds. The scooter is built for riders who want strong performance without moving into the heaviest Dualtron models.

Display and Controls

The scooter is equipped with modern Dualtron control hardware, giving the rider access to speed modes, riding settings, battery information, and system feedback. The display allows quick monitoring of key ride data, including speed and battery level. Adjustable riding modes let the rider choose between stronger performance or more efficient range use, depending on the journey.

Ride and Suspension

The Victor Luxury Plus is designed to give a stable and comfortable ride across city roads, uneven surfaces, and longer routes. Its suspension system helps absorb vibration and road impact, improving rider comfort and wheel contact. Combined with pneumatic tyres, the setup provides a smoother ride than solid tyre scooters while maintaining grip and control during acceleration, braking, and cornering.

Braking and Safety

The braking system is built to match the scooter’s 4300W output and 85 km/h top speed capability. Strong braking performance gives the rider controlled stopping power during normal use and emergency situations. Regenerative braking support helps reduce brake wear and adds extra deceleration when configured correctly. This combination gives the Victor Luxury Plus predictable braking for a powerful dual motor scooter.

Lighting and Visibility

The scooter includes integrated lighting to improve visibility during low-light riding. Front, rear, and side lighting help make the scooter more visible to other road users. The lighting system is designed to support safer riding in traffic, at night, and in poor visibility conditions while keeping the scooter’s clean Dualtron design.

Handling and Comfort

The 35 kg frame weight gives the Victor Luxury Plus a balanced feel, with enough mass for stability but without becoming excessively heavy. The wide handlebars, grippy deck, and dual motor traction help the rider stay in control during acceleration and cornering. The 60V system delivers smooth power, while the low and stable riding position helps reduce vibration and improve confidence at speed.

Craftsmanship and Longevity

The Victor Luxury Plus is built with serviceability and long-term use in mind. Key parts such as tyres, brakes, suspension components, and electrical items can be maintained or replaced when needed. The frame, battery system, and dual motor setup are designed for repeated use across commuting and performance riding. Regular maintenance of brakes, tyres, bolts, and charging equipment will help keep the scooter performing correctly over time.

Conclusion

The Dualtron New Victor Luxury Plus 60V 31.5Ah combines a 1.9 kWh battery, dual 4300W hub motors, 85 km/h top speed, and up to 95 km rated range in a 35 kg performance scooter. It is designed for riders who want strong acceleration, long range, and stable handling without choosing a larger and heavier model. With its dual motor power, practical weight, and refined Victor platform, it remains one of the strongest midweight performance scooters in the Dualtron range.

Frame and Portability

Safety and Braking

Lighting and Visibility

Display and Connectivity

Conclusion

The Dualtron Togo Plus 2025 48V 15Ah delivers 650W of efficient power, 25 mph top speed, and 25 mi of range in a compact, 24 kg frame. Combining high-grade suspension, electronic braking, and app connectivity, it’s a versatile electric scooter for riders seeking everyday reliability and comfort with Dualtron performance DNA.

title: ROVORON S7 84V 37.1Ah
body_html:
The Rovoron S7 is a flagship high-performance electric scooter engineered for riders seeking extreme power, long-distance capability and advanced technology. Featuring an 84V electrical system, dual 2500W motors and a premium Samsung battery pack, the S7 delivers exceptional acceleration, high-speed stability and impressive real-world range while maintaining rider comfort and safety.

At the heart of the scooter is a powerful dual-drive system powered by two 2500W brushless hub motors. Controlled by dual 40A controllers, the system delivers strong acceleration, responsive throttle control and excellent climbing performance. With a top speed of up to 100km/h (60mph), the Rovoron S7 is designed for experienced riders who demand serious performance.

Energy is supplied by a high-capacity 84V 37.1Ah Samsung battery built using premium Samsung INR21700-53G automotive-grade lithium cells. The 3.1kWh battery pack provides a maximum range of up to 150km (90 miles) under ideal riding conditions. An intelligent Battery Management System continuously monitors battery health and provides multiple layers of protection for improved safety, reliability and long-term performance.

The Rovoron S7 features the latest EY4 4.2-inch LCD Bluetooth display, offering a large easy-to-read dashboard that displays speed, battery status, mileage, temperature, riding mode, lighting status and diagnostic information. Bluetooth connectivity allows pairing with the Minimotors mobile application for advanced settings, ride monitoring and software integration.

A Bluetooth keyless unlocking system enhances convenience and security. When enabled through the mobile app, the scooter can automatically unlock as the rider approaches, while anti-theft and password protection features help safeguard the vehicle when parked.

Ride comfort is provided by an advanced front and rear dual suspension system featuring patented adjustable cartridge dampers. The suspension allows multi-level tuning to balance comfort, handling and durability while reducing the effects of rough terrain and road imperfections. Large 11-inch tubeless tyres provide excellent grip, puncture resistance and stability across a variety of riding surfaces.

Braking performance is delivered through premium NUTT four-piston hydraulic disc brakes with 160mm brake rotors. ABS and EBS electronic braking systems provide additional stopping control and braking stability, particularly during high-speed riding and emergency braking situations.

The scooter incorporates a forged aluminium folding mechanism with multiple safety locks to provide secure operation and improved structural strength. The reinforced frame design increases rigidity and impact resistance while maintaining reliable folding functionality for transport and storage.

Visibility and rider safety are enhanced through a comprehensive lighting package. A powerful 30W high-brightness front headlight illuminates the road ahead, while integrated front and rear turn signals, tail lights, hazard warning lights and reflectors improve visibility to other road users. Full-body RGB ambient lighting is integrated into the stem, side covers, swingarms and chassis, with colours and effects fully customisable through the mobile application.

Supporting riders up to 120kg, the Rovoron S7 weighs approximately 49.7kg and measures 1280 x 640 x 1350mm when unfolded. Folded dimensions are 1280 x 318 x 610mm for easier storage and transport. An optional seat is available for riders seeking additional comfort during longer journeys.

Combining an 84V Samsung battery system, dual 2500W motors, premium hydraulic braking, adjustable suspension, Bluetooth connectivity, keyless unlocking and fully customisable RGB lighting, the Rovoron S7 delivers flagship-level performance for riders seeking power, technology and long-range capability in a single package.

title: DUALTRON SONIC MODEL A ALIEN 72V 40Ah (BLACK)
body_html:
Dualtron Sonic Alien 72V 40Ah (Black)

The Dualtron Sonic Alien 72V 40Ah is a flagship high-performance electric scooter engineered for extreme power, advanced electronic control systems, and modular serviceability. Built on a forged AL6062-T6 aluminum chassis, it delivers exceptional rigidity, durability, and stability under high loads and high speeds.

The Sonic Alien is powered by dual BLDC hub motors rated at 2500W ×2, paired with a high-capacity 72V 40Ah lithium battery using premium 21700 cells (Samsung 50S 9C or LG INR21700H51T 9C). A next-generation controller delivers DC110A in normal mode and DC140A in turbo mode, providing high power density with improved protection and cleaner wiring.

A patented active motor cooling system actively manages motor temperature to maintain consistent output and enhance long-term durability. The modular front and rear wheel design allows the tyre and hub to be removed separately, while motor connectors are housed inside the swing arms for easier maintenance and cleaner cable routing.

Braking performance is handled by NUTT 4-piston hydraulic brakes with 160 mm discs, supported by ABS + EBS + CBS combined braking systems. The linked braking configuration distributes braking force intelligently for improved stability during emergency stops. An adjustable hydraulic steering damper is fitted as standard to enhance high-speed control.

The suspension system features a fully mechanical front and rear setup with interchangeable leaf-spring cartridges and adjustable gaskets, engineered to balance comfort, durability, and temperature isolation across varied riding conditions.

Lighting and visibility are comprehensive, featuring a 45W automatic front headlight, sequential front and rear turn signals, rear tail light, reflectors, and RGB ambient lighting integrated into the stem and body. Ambient lighting is fully app-controlled, allowing customization of color, lighting mode, animation speed, and on/off control.

Smart systems include a TFT color display (EYA) with automatic brightness adjustment via an ambient light sensor, built-in GPS, Bluetooth app connectivity, anti-theft alarm, horn, electric brake signal, voltmeter control, and an integrated Battery Management System (BMS). Additional safety systems include traction control (TCS) and an AVAS acoustic alert system.

Equipped with 11-inch run-flat tyres, a two-wheel-drive system, and a reinforced forged frame, the Dualtron Sonic Alien is designed for riders who demand maximum performance, advanced technology, and long-term serviceability in a single platform.

Key Specifications

  • Battery: 72V 40Ah (Samsung 21700 50S 9C or LG INR21700H51T 9C)
  • Motors: Dual BLDC hub motors, 2500W ×2
  • Controller: DC110A (Normal Mode) / DC140A (Turbo Mode)
  • Drive System: Two-wheel drive
  • Maximum Speed: Approx. 110 km/h
  • Range: Approx. 125 km (at 25 km/h, 75 kg load)
  • Tyres: 11-inch run-flat tyres
  • Brakes: NUTT 4-piston hydraulic brakes, 160 mm discs, ABS + EBS + CBS
  • Suspension: Front & rear mechanical suspension with interchangeable cartridges
  • Lighting: 45W automatic front headlight, RGB ambient lighting, sequential indicators
  • Display: TFT color display (EYA) with ambient light sensor
  • Net Weight: Approx. 53.5 kg
  • Maximum Load: 120 kg
  • Seat: Optional accessory (sold separately)

Performance figures are based on controlled laboratory testing. Actual performance may vary depending on rider weight, terrain, temperature, and riding style.

title: DUALTRON TOGO LIMITED 60V 15Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Togo LTD 2025 | 60V 15Ah | 1000W

The Dualtron Togo LTD 2025 takes urban mobility to a new level with its 1000W single hub motor and Samsung 60V 15Ah battery system. Delivering 0.9 kWh of usable energy, it achieves up to 50 km (30 mi) of range and a top speed of 50 km/h (30 mph). With powerful torque and a 27% hill-climb capability, the Togo LTD handles city streets and inclines with ease while maintaining efficient power delivery through its advanced BMS protection.

Performance and Power System

The 60V platform ensures strong, stable current output to the motor, allowing rapid acceleration and steady cruising speeds. The integrated Smart BMS protects against overheating, short circuits, and over-current events, ensuring long-term reliability. Charging through a 66.4V 1.75A port restores full capacity in about nine hours, making it convenient for daily use.

Frame, Dimensions, and Structure

Constructed from reinforced aluminum alloy, the frame weighs only 25 kg while supporting riders up to 100 kg. The Togo LTD’s geometry includes a 985 mm wheelbase and 130 mm of ground clearance, providing excellent stability and protection against curbs or bumps. Folded dimensions of 1230 × 635 × 460 mm make it practical for storage and transport.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

Dual spring suspension cartridges on both ends absorb shocks effectively, while 10×3-inch pneumatic tires ensure consistent grip and traction across road surfaces. The result is a balanced, cushioned ride ideal for commuting or light off-road paths.

Braking and Safety

Front and rear mechanical disc brakes work in conjunction with ABS and EBS for precise stopping power even on slick or uneven roads. The system provides firm lever response and progressive braking under all conditions.

Display and Connectivity

The EY2 Display presents real-time data including speed, battery level, and riding mode, and connects to the Dualtron mobile app via Bluetooth. Riders can adjust acceleration profiles, lighting, and diagnostic parameters directly from their smartphones.

Lighting and Protection

A bright LED headlight, under-deck RGB strips, and a rear fender-mounted brake light ensure visibility in all conditions. IP55-rated sealing resists dust and light water spray, while modular deck access simplifies maintenance and wiring inspection.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Togo LTD 2025 60V 15Ah merges 1000W motor power, 30 mph speed, and 30 mi range in a 25 kg frame engineered for daily performance. With Samsung battery reliability, dual suspension, and full IP55 protection, it stands as the ultimate lightweight commuter scooter for riders who demand real-world power, comfort, and efficiency.

title: DUALTRON AMINIA LONG BODY 52V 21Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Aminia Long Body Dual Motor 2025 52V 21Ah

The Dualtron Aminia Long Body Dual Motor 2025 elevates compact performance with the integration of a 52V 21Ah Samsung lithium battery pack offering 1.1 kWh capacity. This high-density battery powers dual 450W BLDC hub motors for a total of 1800W peak power. The setup achieves speeds up to 60 km/h (40 mph) while maintaining stability and precise control. Designed for riders up to 100 kg, the Aminia balances high output with manageable weight at just 30 kg, creating a scooter that performs equally well in city and off-road conditions.

Performance and Battery

The 52V platform efficiently delivers current to both motors, producing smooth acceleration, strong hill-climbing ability, and consistent torque even at low speed. With a rated 21Ah capacity, the Samsung cells provide reliable endurance and clean power output across the 60 km range (40 mi). The integrated BMS manages temperature and voltage stability, protecting against overcharging and ensuring steady discharge during heavy use.

Design and Build

The Aminia Long Body uses an extended aluminum frame measuring 1200 x 620 x 1220 mm unfolded, offering more deck space for better stance and control. When folded to 1280 x 310 x 420 mm, it becomes compact enough for storage or transport. The reinforced chassis supports riders up to 100 kg without flex or instability. At 30 kg, it retains portability while feeling planted at high speed. The low center of gravity and balanced geometry enhance comfort during long rides.

Suspension and Tires

Equipped with front and rear spring-rubber suspension, the Aminia absorbs uneven road surfaces effectively. Its 9-inch tubeless tires ensure traction on asphalt and light trails. Riders can opt for self-sealing variants to improve puncture resistance. Together, this suspension and tire setup provides a comfortable and secure experience across varying terrain.

Braking System

Safety and control are supported by dual drum brakes paired with advanced ABS and EBS systems. The EBS activates at battery temperatures above 55°C, preserving braking performance while protecting internal circuits. This dual braking structure gives reliable stopping power and consistent response, whether in urban traffic or downhill sections.

Controls and Display

The Aminia 2025 includes the NEW EY3 display, combining clarity and functionality. It connects with the Dualtron App via Bluetooth, allowing riders to monitor speed, distance, battery percentage, and system health in real time. The handlebar-mounted multi-switch enables easy access to headlights, horn, indicators, and power modes without distracting from the ride.

Lighting and Safety

Lighting is fully integrated with an E-mark certified headlight, tail and brake lights, turn indicators, and side reflectors for all-around visibility. These components are built to meet road safety standards and perform efficiently without draining the battery. The system ensures visibility from all directions, day or night.

Water Resistance and Durability

Rated IPX5, the Aminia resists splashes and rain, keeping key electronics protected. The silicone deck coating provides superior grip and moisture protection, while the compact wiring system prevents damage from vibration or exposure. Combined, these features guarantee consistent operation under a range of environmental conditions.

Ride Experience

Dual 450W motors distribute torque evenly across both wheels, giving stable acceleration and smooth handling. The wide deck and responsive suspension enhance balance and comfort. Whether climbing a 30% slope or maneuvering through tight corners, the Aminia maintains precision and agility. The quiet drivetrain and robust power delivery make every ride confident and efficient.

Charging and Maintenance

The top-mounted charging ports improve accessibility and safety, while Samsung’s cell chemistry ensures long-term cycle life. Maintenance remains straightforward thanks to modular construction—brakes, wheels, and suspension components can be serviced easily without removing the motor assembly.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Aminia Long Body Dual Motor 52V 21Ah delivers dependable 1800W dual-motor power, a 60 km range, and 60 km/h top speed in a portable 30 kg build. Its 21Ah Samsung battery, IPX5 protection, and full lighting suite create a versatile, commuter-friendly scooter built for reliability, balance, and performance. Ideal for riders seeking compact size without compromising power or quality.

title: DUALTRON AMINIA SPECIAL 52V 17.5Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Aminia Special 2025 52V 17.5Ah Single Motor

The Dualtron Aminia Special 2025 delivers efficient performance in a lightweight frame. Powered by a 52V 17.5Ah Samsung battery (910 Wh) and a single 450W BLDC hub motor, it reaches speeds up to 55 km/h (35 mph) with a range of 50 km (30 mi). Designed for everyday riders, the 25 kg chassis supports up to 100 kg, making it an agile and durable choice for both city and off-road environments.

Power and Battery

The 52V 17.5Ah lithium battery, built with Samsung 21700 cells, ensures reliable energy flow and longevity. With 0.9 kWh total capacity, it delivers steady output across its entire charge cycle, enabling strong acceleration and consistent top-end power. The 450W rear-mounted motor drives efficiently, balancing torque and range for smooth, controlled performance across mixed terrain.

Ride and Suspension

The Aminia’s spring-rubber suspension system provides comfort and stability on uneven roads. Both front and rear suspension units absorb shocks effectively, while 9-inch tubeless tires maintain traction and minimize vibration. Optional self-sealing tires enhance puncture resistance for riders who prefer added protection on longer commutes or rougher routes.

Braking and Safety

Front and rear drum brakes form a dependable braking system supported by electronic ABS and EBS. The EBS engages thermal protection at 55°C, ensuring consistent braking performance and component safety. Together, these systems deliver controlled stopping distance and confidence under various riding conditions.

Display and Controls

The Aminia Special includes the EY3 display paired with the Dualtron App. Through Bluetooth connectivity, riders can track speed, range, and battery status in real time. The handlebar-mounted multi-switch gives quick access to lights, horn, and turn indicators, offering intuitive control without compromising focus.

Design and Build

Weighing 25 kg, the Aminia Special uses a reinforced aluminum frame capable of supporting riders up to 100 kg. The low deck height improves balance and control, especially during acceleration. With folded dimensions of 1250 x 304 x 410 mm, it remains easy to carry and store, while the unfolded stance of 1150 x 610 x 1195 mm provides ample riding stability.

Climbing and Performance

The single 450W motor delivers enough torque to climb gradients up to 26.8% (15°). Combined with the 52V power system and 17.5Ah battery, it maintains steady thrust uphill without overheating. This makes the Aminia Special ideal for riders tackling mixed elevation routes in urban and suburban areas.

Lighting and Waterproofing

The IPX5-rated body shields internal electronics from splashes and light rain, maintaining consistent performance in all weather. The lighting system includes an E-mark certified headlight, rear tail and brake lights, turn signals, and side reflectors. Together they ensure visibility and safety both day and night.

Deck and Comfort Features

A silicone-covered deck improves grip and water resistance while enhancing rider comfort. Charging ports are positioned on the deck top for easy access. The wiring layout remains compact and protected, minimizing wear and simplifying maintenance over time.

Handling and Experience

The Aminia’s geometry, coupled with a balanced 52V power system, creates smooth acceleration and stable steering response. The combination of suspension travel and deck space makes longer rides fatigue-free while maintaining control at higher speeds. Whether navigating crowded streets or open paths, it offers a refined yet exciting experience.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Aminia Special 52V 17.5Ah embodies Dualtron’s precision engineering in a compact, single-motor form. With its 55 km/h top speed, 50 km range, Samsung battery reliability, IPX5 protection, and sturdy 25 kg frame, it delivers dependable, spirited riding with the hallmark Dualtron control and build quality expected from Minimotors.

title: DUALTRON AMINIA SPECIAL 52V 13Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Aminia 2025 – Compact Power with Everyday Versatility

The Dualtron Aminia 2025 52V 13Ah redefines lightweight electric mobility with improved efficiency, waterproofing, and all-round performance. Built for riders seeking a compact yet capable scooter, it delivers confident acceleration, reliable braking, and a smooth, stable ride in both city and suburban environments.

Performance and Ride Experience

The Aminia 2025 uses an efficient single 900W hub motor tuned for balanced acceleration and torque. It offers enough power for steep city climbs and consistent cruising at medium-to-high speeds. Combined with the lightweight 25 kg chassis, the scooter feels agile and responsive, ideal for daily commuting or weekend exploration.

New for 2025

Waterproof IPX5 Construction

The latest Aminia body design achieves an IPX5 waterproof rating, shielding all core components from rain and splash exposure. Cable routing and connector seals have been fully redesigned for long-term reliability.

Upgraded Display and App Integration

The waterproof EY3 display provides real-time data and integrates directly with the Dualtron App for battery tracking, speed control, lighting settings, and fault diagnostics. Riders can adjust settings, monitor performance, and secure their scooter with advanced digital pairing.

Enhanced Safety Features

The combination of front and rear drum brakes, EBS electronic braking, and built-in ABS ensures precise stopping power in both wet and dry conditions. The EBS system automatically moderates brake force to protect the battery and control heat when temperatures exceed safe levels.

Comfort and Control

Front and rear spring-rubber suspension absorb shocks from rough surfaces, maintaining stability and traction. The 9-inch tubeless tires increase grip and reduce puncture risk. Self-sealing tire options are available for riders prioritizing durability over long-distance use.

Design and Practicality

The Aminia 2025 maintains Dualtron’s signature folding mechanism for easy storage and transport. The reinforced hinge locks securely, keeping the frame solid even after extended use. Folded dimensions allow compact placement in car boots, hallways, or under desks.

Lighting and Visibility

The integrated headlight and horn meet E-mark standards, while rear brake lights, turn indicators, and side reflectors provide clear visibility at all angles. The lighting system is bright, energy-efficient, and optimized for both daytime and night rides.

Rider Comfort and Ergonomics

The silicone-coated deck ensures slip resistance even in wet weather. The balanced weight distribution between deck and handlebar keeps steering stable at speed. All controls are positioned within easy thumb reach, offering intuitive command over lights, horn, and indicators.

Technology and Connectivity

Through the Dualtron App, riders can view ride statistics, adjust acceleration curves, and perform quick diagnostics. The EY3 interface simplifies all monitoring tasks and links securely via Bluetooth to mobile devices.

Battery and Charging

The 52V 13Ah battery uses high-efficiency cells for steady voltage output and longer cycle life. Located securely inside a sealed compartment, it offers consistent discharge and faster recovery between rides. The top-mounted charging ports simplify access and prevent water ingress during charging.

Durability and Maintenance

The chassis, folding joint, and deck mount have been strengthened to reduce vibration fatigue. The enclosed wiring system minimizes exposure to dust and debris. Maintenance access to the controller and main cables is simplified through removable deck panels.

Everyday Versatility

Weighing only 25 kg, the Aminia 2025 can be carried upstairs or loaded into vehicles with ease. It supports riders up to 100 kg and climbs slopes of roughly 15 degrees without loss of power. This balance of portability and torque makes it an ideal solution for mixed commuting environments.

In the Box

Each Dualtron Aminia 2025 includes a standard charger, charging cable, instruction manual, and a basic tool kit. Optional upgrades include self-sealing tires, fast charger, and a silicone deck cover for enhanced grip and style.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Aminia 2025 combines strong build quality, IPX5 waterproofing, reliable braking, and advanced app integration into a lightweight frame. It offers the essential Dualtron riding experience in a more compact and efficient package, ideal for riders who want power, comfort, and practicality in one refined scooter.

title: DUALTRON SONIC MODEL N NANO 36V 10.2Ah (BLACK)
body_html:
Dualtron Sonic Nano Black 2025 | Model N 36V 10.2Ah

The Dualtron Sonic Nano Black 2025 redefines compact electric scooter design with efficiency, strength, and modern styling. Powered by dual 250W hub motors delivering a combined 700W peak output, it achieves a top speed of 25 km/h (15 mph) while maintaining smooth torque delivery for urban rides. The 36V 10.2Ah CHINA 2000 battery provides up to 20 km (10 mi) of range per charge, ideal for daily commutes and city errands. Weighing only 15 kg, it supports riders up to 100 kg and prioritizes lightweight performance without compromising durability.

Battery and Power System

The 0.3 kWh lithium battery ensures stable voltage and consistent discharge, optimizing current flow to both motors for linear acceleration. Its 36V setup is engineered for energy efficiency, keeping performance steady across various speed modes. The removable design allows easy charging flexibility at home or in the office.

Build and Structure

The Sonic Nano features a reinforced aluminum-alloy frame with a wide, non-slip deck for improved control. Its folding system includes a dual-lock mechanism that enhances rigidity while allowing quick folding for portability. Compact geometry and balanced weight distribution ensure stable handling even at maximum load.

Suspension and Tires

Front and rear suspension units absorb road vibration, providing a smoother and quieter ride. The 10-inch solid tires eliminate punctures and minimize maintenance while delivering consistent traction on urban surfaces.

Braking and Safety

Equipped with dual drum brakes and regenerative EBS, the Sonic Nano delivers reliable, controlled braking power. The braking system balances front and rear response for stability during deceleration, recovering small amounts of energy to extend range.

Lighting and Visibility

The built-in LED headlight and tail light improve visibility during night rides, while reflective side markers increase on-road safety. All lighting components are IPX5 rated for resistance against light rain and dust exposure.

Display and Controls

The EY2 Smart Display provides instant access to speed, battery status, and riding data. Riders can adjust modes and lighting directly from the interface, designed for clear visibility even under sunlight.

Folding and Portability

The Dualtron Sonic Nano folds quickly and securely with its upgraded locking system. At 15 kg, it’s compact enough for storage in car trunks, office spaces, or small flats—making it one of the most portable models in the Dualtron lineup.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Sonic Nano Black 2025 blends 700W of peak power, 15 mph top speed, and 10 mi range in a lightweight frame built for daily use. With solid tires, full suspension, and premium safety features, it’s the ideal short-range commuter scooter from Minimotors.

title: DUALTRON VICTOR LIMITED 60V 28Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Victor LTD 2025 60V 28Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Victor LTD 2025 takes the proven Victor platform to the next level, combining high-performance dual motors, the latest EY4 display technology, and a completely redesigned steering and folding system. Engineered for riders who demand precision, control, and reliability, it delivers a refined and powerful ride built to excel in all conditions.

Power and Performance

Equipped with dual 1300W motors for a total nominal output of 2600W, the Victor LTD 2025 reaches speeds up to 80 km/h while maintaining excellent torque and traction. The 60V powertrain ensures consistent acceleration and climbing ability, capable of handling slopes up to 35°. It’s built to provide smooth performance whether on paved streets or rugged off-road paths.

Battery and Range

Available in two configurations 60V 28Ah CN or 60V 35Ah Samsung cells the Victor LTD offers flexibility for different riders. The standard 28Ah version provides up to 90 km of range, while the Samsung 35Ah variant extends the range up to 110 km. The high-capacity battery delivers strong current output and stable voltage across the entire charge cycle for efficient energy use and long service life.

Steering and Folding System

The Victor LTD features a completely new steering system derived from the Thunder 3 and Storm New models. The upgraded design enhances handling precision and cornering stability. The reinforced folding mechanism combines strength with convenience, ensuring easy transport and improved durability during long-term use.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

Front and rear suspension cartridges provide superior shock absorption across a wide range of terrain. The modular cartridge system allows for easy replacement and tuning, enabling riders to adjust stiffness for comfort or performance. This setup ensures a controlled and balanced ride even at higher speeds.

Braking and Safety

The Minimotors-designed hydraulic braking system delivers exceptional stopping power and control. Custom-made calipers and levers ensure consistent pressure distribution and heat dissipation. The braking setup includes both ABS and EBS systems, providing safe, stable deceleration under all conditions. The electric brake system incorporates battery temperature protection to prevent overheating during extended use.

Lighting and Visibility

A powerful 30W front headlight provides clear illumination for night riding, complemented by integrated rear lights and indicators. The EY4 system also manages the RGB accent lighting for improved visibility and aesthetic appeal. The entire lighting setup is optimized for road safety and long-term reliability.

Control and Technology

The new EY4 LCD display integrates seamlessly with the Dualtron app via Bluetooth, giving riders full access to performance metrics, ride statistics, and customizable settings. The multi-switch control system enables quick operation of turn signals, eco mode, hazard lights, headlight, and horn, offering a fully intuitive control layout for safe and efficient riding.

Tires and Terrain Handling

The Victor LTD is fitted with 10x3.0-6.5 inch tubeless off-road tires as standard, designed to deliver grip and stability across varied terrain. The wide tread pattern provides traction on dirt, gravel, and tarmac while maintaining low rolling resistance for improved range.

Frame and Build Quality

Weighing 35 kg, the Victor LTD combines a compact form factor with reinforced structural rigidity. The aluminum alloy frame is engineered for strength while maintaining balance and control. With a 120 kg maximum load capacity, it accommodates a broad range of riders and riding conditions.

Durability and Maintenance

The Victor LTD’s new mechanical layout allows easy access to the rear wheel and braking system for simplified servicing. Weather-resistant wiring and sealed electronic components ensure durability against moisture and dust exposure. Every mechanical part has been optimized for endurance and reduced maintenance intervals.

In the Box

Included: standard charger, power cable, user manual, nut caps, and tool kit. Optional accessories include fast charger, seat kit, and extended deck mat.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Victor LTD 2025 60V 28Ah combines strength, intelligence, and design refinement into a high-performance package. With its 2600W dual motor setup, EY4 control system, Nutt hydraulic brakes, and advanced suspension, it stands as one of the most versatile and capable models in the Dualtron lineup. Designed for serious riders, it delivers both thrill and reliability on every ride.

title: DUALTRON VICTOR LIMITED 60V 35Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Victor Limited 60V 35Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Victor LTD 2025 stands as a premium evolution of the Victor lineup, engineered for both precision and endurance. With dual 1300W motors, a 60V 35Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery, and the advanced EY4 display, it merges high-end technology, robust design, and off-road capability into a compact yet powerful frame. Designed for riders seeking versatility and refinement, the Victor LTD 2025 delivers consistent performance across all terrains.

Power and Performance

The Victor LTD 2025 features dual hub motors providing a total nominal output of 2600W, delivering smooth torque and reliable acceleration. The 60V system ensures efficient power transfer and stability even at higher speeds, reaching up to 80 km/h under optimal conditions. Its superior torque curve allows it to tackle steep inclines up to 35° with ease, making it equally capable in city traffic and off-road exploration.

Battery and Range

Powered by a 60V 35Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery, the Victor LTD 2025 achieves an extended range of up to 120 km per charge. With a total energy capacity of 2.1 kWh, the scooter offers excellent voltage stability and consistent discharge rates. The battery management system prevents overcurrent, overcharge, and thermal stress, ensuring long-term reliability for daily and high-performance use.

Control and Technology

At the heart of the Victor LTD’s control system lies the new EY4 LCD display with full Bluetooth connectivity and app integration. Riders can monitor speed, voltage, range, and temperature in real time, while adjusting acceleration modes, regenerative braking, and light settings through the Dualtron app. The interface also provides PIN protection and diagnostic data for a secure and personalized experience.

Steering and Folding System

Inspired by the Thunder 3 and Storm New models, the Victor LTD adopts a re-engineered steering column for improved rigidity and responsiveness. The new folding mechanism enhances structural strength while maintaining portability, making the scooter easier to transport without compromising ride stability or safety.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

Equipped with front and rear suspension cartridges, the Victor LTD 2025 provides a balanced combination of comfort and performance. The modular suspension system allows riders to replace or adjust cartridges for specific riding styles, ensuring optimal shock absorption and control on both urban and off-road routes.

Braking and Safety

The Minimotors hydraulic braking system features custom calipers and reinforced brake levers for superior modulation and stopping power. Combined with ABS and EBS electronic braking systems, it delivers reliable performance across all surfaces. The EBS system includes a temperature protection function that regulates energy recovery and prevents battery overheating during prolonged braking.

Lighting and Visibility

A powerful 30W front headlight illuminates the road ahead, while integrated taillights, indicators, and side reflectors ensure full visibility at night. The lighting system is fully controlled via the multi-switch module, allowing riders to manage headlight, hazard lights, and turn signals without distraction.

Frame and Build Quality

Constructed from aerospace-grade aluminum alloy, the Victor LTD 2025 achieves an ideal balance of strength and weight at 37 kg. Its extended deck and reinforced frame improve foot stability and handling. The scooter supports a maximum load of 120 kg, delivering consistent performance for a wide range of riders and riding conditions.

Tires and Terrain Handling

Standard 10x3.0-6.5 inch tubeless off-road tires provide enhanced traction and cornering grip. Designed for mixed terrain, they perform equally well on asphalt and dirt surfaces, maintaining control in varied weather conditions. Combined with the scooter’s wide wheelbase and adjustable suspension, the Victor LTD offers exceptional riding stability.

Multi-Switch Functionality

The new handlebar multi-switch system provides intuitive access to essential controls, including eco mode, horn, indicators, and lighting. The ergonomically positioned layout allows riders to adjust settings quickly while maintaining full control of the throttle and brakes.

Durability and Maintenance

Upgraded mechanical components simplify servicing and improve long-term reliability. The new rear mudguard uses external screws for quick wheel access, while internal cable routing enhances water resistance and durability. Every detail reflects Dualtron’s focus on performance, safety, and ease of ownership.

In the Box

Includes standard charger, power cable, nut caps, multi-tool, and user manual. Optional accessories such as a fast charger, seat kit, and extended deck mat are available separately.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Victor LTD 2025 60V 35Ah combines 2600W dual motor performance, advanced EY4 connectivity, and high-grade LG battery power into a refined, robust platform. With its upgraded steering, hydraulic brakes, off-road tires, and integrated app control, it sets a new standard for reliability and comfort in the Dualtron mid-range segment built for riders who expect power, range, and precision in one complete package.
