title: DUALTRON NEW THUNDER 2 72V 32Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Thunder 2 2025 72V 32Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Thunder 2 2025 brings a new generation of high-performance engineering to Minimotors’ flagship series. Featuring dual 10080W hub motors and a 72V 32Ah power system, it delivers unmatched acceleration, stability, and control. With the new EY4 display and app integration, riders gain advanced connectivity and real-time data access, making this one of the most capable scooters in the Dualtron range.

Power and Performance

The dual BLDC hub motor system produces up to 10080W peak output, providing powerful acceleration and a top speed of 100 km/h. The 72V powertrain ensures smooth torque delivery, consistent energy efficiency, and stable performance even under heavy load. The scooter maintains its agility while supporting riders up to 100 kg, offering balanced handling for both urban and long-distance rides.

Battery and Range

The Thunder 2 2025 is powered by a 72V 32Ah battery using CHINA 21700 cells, engineered for reliable current output and temperature control. This high-capacity pack allows a range of up to 130 km on a single charge, depending on terrain and riding mode. Dual charging ports allow for faster recharging, reducing downtime between rides. The battery’s compact layout keeps the center of gravity low, improving balance and cornering stability.

EY4 Display and Connectivity

The upgraded waterproof EY4 display enhances visibility and integrates seamlessly with the Minimotors app. Riders can monitor real-time statistics such as speed, voltage, and distance while adjusting ride settings directly from their smartphone. Security PIN protection, Bluetooth pairing, and performance tuning features provide more control and safety than ever before.

Chassis and Frame Design

The Thunder 2 2025 continues Dualtron’s legacy of precision build quality. Its reinforced aluminum frame supports heavy-duty use while maintaining excellent rigidity. The folding stem and locking mechanism have been refined for smoother operation and increased durability. The compact, symmetrical structure improves both handling and long-term reliability under continuous load.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

The adjustable suspension system combines front and rear cartridge dampers for responsive control on all terrain types. Riders can customize stiffness to suit their weight and surface conditions, achieving an optimal balance between comfort and stability. The long deck and wide tires further enhance traction and shock absorption.

Braking and Safety

Hydraulic disc brakes on both wheels provide strong, predictable stopping power. Regenerative electronic braking complements the hydraulic system, improving battery efficiency while reducing mechanical wear. The Thunder 2’s braking system ensures consistent deceleration even during high-speed descents or wet weather riding.

Lighting and Visibility

The lighting package includes dual LED headlights, rear brake lights, side indicators, and under-deck RGB lighting. The improved light spread enhances night visibility while giving the scooter its distinctive Dualtron identity. Lighting functions are accessible through the left-hand multi-switch for quick operation while riding.

Design and Aesthetics

The Thunder 2’s design emphasizes both function and form. Its low-slung profile improves stability at speed, while the wide silicone-coated deck enhances grip and comfort. The clean cable layout and black anodized finish reflect Dualtron’s commitment to professional-grade craftsmanship.

Waterproofing and Durability

High-quality insulation and sealing protect the Thunder 2’s internal components from dust and moisture. The EY4 system and battery compartment feature advanced waterproofing, allowing dependable performance even in light rain or humid conditions.

Technology and Control

Through the EY4 display and Minimotors app, riders can set speed modes, adjust regenerative braking strength, and monitor controller temperature. The improved firmware allows smoother throttle response and reduced latency between input and acceleration. These refinements make the Thunder 2 one of the most responsive models in its class.

Versions and Display Options

The Dualtron Thunder 2 2025 is available in two configurations: the standard model equipped with the EY3 display, and the new Thunder 2 New edition with the EY4 display and app control. Buyers should confirm preferred version before ordering to ensure the desired setup.

In the Box

Includes standard charger, charging cable, nut caps, multi-tool, and user manual. Optional accessories such as fast charger, seat kit, and handlebar extensions are available separately.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Thunder 2 2025 combines 10080W of motor power, 72V 32Ah battery capacity, and advanced EY4 connectivity into a precision-built platform. It offers extreme performance, long-range capability, and modern rider control in one complete package. Engineered for both power and comfort, it represents the next evolution in the Dualtron performance lineup.

title: DUALTRON DOLPHIN 36V 15Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Dolphin 2025 36V 15Ah Single Motor

The Dualtron Dolphin 2025 36V 15Ah from Minimotors is a compact yet capable electric scooter designed for reliability, portability, and comfort. Powered by a 36V system and a 15Ah lithium battery using China 2600 cells, it delivers a steady output for daily commuting or leisure rides. The single 450W hub motor reaches up to 35 km/h (20 mph) while maintaining excellent control and energy efficiency. With a practical range of 30 km (20 mi) per charge, it provides the right balance between power and endurance for city use.

Battery and Performance

The 15Ah battery, offering 0.5 kWh of capacity, supports consistent voltage output for smooth acceleration and longer cycle life. The Dolphin’s 900W peak power motor responds efficiently to throttle input, producing stable torque across varying terrain. This combination ensures strong performance while maintaining low energy consumption, ideal for urban rides and short commutes.

Build and Portability

Weighing just 21 kg, the Dolphin maintains a lightweight but sturdy frame capable of supporting riders up to 100 kg. Its foldable handlebar and stem design allow fast folding and compact transport, making it easy to store in car trunks or small indoor spaces. The reinforced aluminum construction enhances durability without compromising weight efficiency.

Comfort and Ride Quality

The scooter’s deck features a silicone-coated surface for better grip and wear resistance. Combined with a low riding platform, it provides stability and comfort during longer journeys. The front tubeless self-repair tire and solid rear tire significantly reduce maintenance needs while maintaining ride comfort on uneven surfaces.

Braking and Safety

Braking is handled by a dual mechanical drum system supported by electronic braking (EBS) in the rear motor. This setup ensures smooth and predictable stops while recovering a small amount of energy during deceleration. The braking system has been tuned for responsive control, essential for dense city environments and mixed road conditions.

Controls and Display

The Dualtron Dolphin introduces the EY1 Smart Display with app connectivity. It features Bluetooth pairing, NFC unlock, and real-time monitoring for speed, battery level, and fault diagnostics. Riders can customize settings through the Dualtron App, while the display’s IPX5 protection ensures performance in all weather conditions.

Lighting and Visibility

The integrated lighting system enhances night visibility with a front LED headlight and rear tail light built into the footrest. The design ensures proper illumination without compromising aerodynamics. Reflective elements on the sides increase safety during low-light conditions, providing clear visibility for both rider and surroundings.

Water Resistance and Durability

With an IPX5 rating, the Dolphin withstands splashes and light rain, safeguarding internal electronics and wiring. Its sealed frame design prevents dust and moisture intrusion, improving long-term reliability for frequent outdoor use. The combination of water resistance, silicone deck, and puncture-resistant tires makes it a durable commuter scooter for varying climates.

User Experience

Riders benefit from an intuitive control layout, comfortable stance, and easy handling. The single-motor configuration simplifies maintenance while still delivering reliable acceleration. The Dolphin’s small footprint and strong build make it ideal for riders who prioritize simplicity and efficiency without sacrificing quality.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Dolphin 2025 36V 15Ah offers dependable performance with a 900W peak motor, 35 km/h top speed, and a 21 kg lightweight design. It blends convenience, technology, and safety in one practical scooter. With its IPX5-rated EY1 Smart Display, dual drum brakes, and long-lasting battery system, it delivers a smooth, connected, and low-maintenance urban ride.

body_html:

Lighting and Visibility

The lights illuminate from the deck and footrest, ensuring clear visibility while preserving the scooter’s clean aesthetic. Turn indicators and side reflectors improve rider safety in traffic.

Weather Protection

The Dualtron Dolphin’s IPX5 waterproof rating guarantees resilience against rain and splashes, protecting its internal electronics. Combined with sealed connectors and insulated wiring, it’s designed to stay functional through all-season conditions.

Comfort and Ride Quality

Its light chassis, soft tire composition, and ergonomic deck height give a smooth ride on urban roads. Suspension travel is optimized for everyday comfort, making the Dolphin ideal for commuting over paved paths, sidewalks, or light off-road sections.

Why Choose the Dualtron Dolphin 2025

Build and Weight

Comfort and Ride Quality

Braking and Safety

Controls and Display

Lighting and Visibility

Weather Protection

The Dolphin carries an IPX5 rating, meaning it withstands light rain and splashes during regular use. All critical components, including the controller and connectors, are sealed against moisture ingress, extending the scooter’s operational lifespan.

Technology and Connectivity

Beyond simple riding, the Dolphin integrates smart technology with mobile app compatibility. The EY1 system supports real-time diagnostics, trip history, and system updates. These functions make it one of the most connected scooters in its size category, blending convenience with forward-looking design.

Conclusion

title: DUALTRON TOGO 36V 12Ah
body_html:

The Dualtron Togo 2025 enhances Minimotors’ entry-level series with greater range and comfort. Running on a 36V 12Ah battery built from CHINA 2600 cells, it powers a 420W single hub motor reaching 34 km/h (20 mph) and covers up to 25 km (15 mi) per charge. Weighing 23 kg and supporting riders up to 100 kg, it offers a refined balance of endurance and portability for daily use.

Powertrain and Control

The reliable Square Wave Controller maximizes efficiency by delivering smooth, responsive torque while minimizing noise. Power delivery remains stable across speed ranges, ensuring consistent acceleration and control even under load.

Battery System and Range

The 0.4 kWh 36V 12Ah lithium battery provides long-lasting energy output for commutes or leisure rides. Built with CHINA 2600 cells, it maintains voltage stability and discharge consistency, extending both performance and cycle life.

Ride Comfort and Suspension

Front and rear variable spring suspension absorb road shocks effectively, while 9-inch tires provide traction and vibration damping. Together, they deliver a smooth, stable ride across varied urban surfaces.

Frame and Folding Design

The lightweight aluminum alloy frame ensures rigidity without excess weight. Its two-touch folding mechanism collapses the scooter to 1160 x 600 x 400 mm, ideal for compact storage and transport.

Safety and Electrical Protection

Turn indicators enhance rider visibility, and IPX5-rated waterproofing shields wiring against moisture. The integrated Smart BMS protects against overcharge, overcurrent, short circuit, undervoltage, temperature rise, and over-discharge, ensuring operational safety.

Practical Performance

With a 23 kg chassis, 420W motor, and efficient energy management, the Togo achieves 34 km/h top speed and 25 km range. It remains one of the most compact, reliable Dualtron scooters for short to medium commutes.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Togo 2025 36V 12Ah delivers 420W of power, 20 mph speed, and 15 mi range in a durable, IPX5-protected frame. With advanced BMS safety, dual suspension, and folding portability, it’s the ideal entry point into Dualtron’s precision engineering and performance heritage.

title: DUALTRON COMPACT 60V 24Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Compact 2025 60V 24Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Compact 2025 continues Minimotors’ tradition of power and portability in a smaller form factor. Driven by dual BLDC hub motors producing a combined 3400W, this 60V electric scooter delivers both agility and high performance. Its 24Ah battery, composed of durable China 21700 cells, stores 1.4 kWh of energy, enabling a top speed of 70 km/h (40 mph) and a range reaching 85 km (50 mi). Weighing just 32 kg, the Compact supports riders up to 120 kg, offering exceptional strength for its size and category.

Power and Battery

The 60V powertrain ensures strong torque and fast acceleration, ideal for urban riding or moderate hills. With a 24Ah battery using China 21700 cells, the Compact provides reliable discharge stability and efficient energy use. The system’s BMS monitors voltage and temperature for maximum cell life. Riders can expect consistent output across the full charge cycle and fast recharging through the dual-port system.

Performance and Range

The dual hub motors deliver 3400W total peak power, maintaining high traction and balance at speed. The combination of torque and top-end performance allows the Compact to reach 70 km/h while preserving smooth throttle response. A single charge covers up to 85 km under ideal conditions, giving ample range for commuting and longer leisure rides.

Build and Design

Constructed with an aerospace-grade aluminum frame, the Compact achieves durability without excess weight. The scooter’s folding stem and compact body make it easy to transport or store in tight spaces. Despite its size, the structural design maintains rigidity, supporting loads up to 120 kg while remaining stable during acceleration and braking.

Ride Comfort and Suspension

The suspension system employs dual rubber cartridges designed to absorb shocks and reduce vibration on rough surfaces. Combined with 8-inch solid tires, it offers responsive handling and eliminates the risk of punctures. This makes the Compact suitable for both city roads and uneven pathways, providing a controlled and steady ride.

Braking and Safety

Equipped with dual drum brakes supported by electronic ABS and regenerative EBS, the Compact delivers secure and balanced stopping power. The braking system’s mechanical reliability combined with electronic feedback ensures effective deceleration at any speed, even under load, while contributing to energy recovery during braking.

Display and Controls

The EY3 display integrates seamlessly with the Dualtron App, offering detailed readings on speed, distance, battery status, and performance modes. The handlebar-mounted multi-switch allows easy activation of headlights, horn, and signal indicators. Controls are intuitive and ergonomically placed for rider convenience.

Lighting and Visibility

The Dualtron Compact includes front and rear LED lighting for visibility in low-light conditions, complemented by side reflectors for additional safety. The lighting system is designed for efficiency, minimizing energy consumption while maintaining strong illumination levels for nighttime rides.

Durability and Practicality

Built for consistent use, the Compact features a closed wiring system and a reinforced deck that protects key components from dust and light moisture. Its compact footprint and low center of gravity make it easy to handle and maneuver, while the solid tire configuration minimizes maintenance requirements.

Handling and Balance

The 32 kg weight and dual-motor setup provide even power distribution, resulting in precise steering and strong traction. The scooter’s geometry and suspension tuning enhance cornering stability while maintaining comfort at cruising speeds, offering confident control for riders of all experience levels.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Compact 2025 60V 24Ah combines high output, durable build, and easy portability in one machine. With 3400W dual motors, 70 km/h top speed, 85 km range, and a 120 kg load capacity, it redefines what a mid-size Dualtron can achieve compact yet powerful, efficient yet thrilling, built for riders seeking performance without compromise.

title: DUALTRON COMPACT 60V 30Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Compact 2025 60V 30Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Compact 2025 is engineered for serious riders seeking a blend of compact design and powerful performance. With dual hub motors delivering 3400W of total power, it reaches speeds up to 70 km/h (40 mph) while maintaining smooth control and stability. Its 60V 30Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery provides high energy efficiency and long-lasting reliability, offering up to 100 km (60 mi) of range on a single charge. At only 32 kg, the Compact manages to combine strength, agility, and endurance within an easily portable frame capable of supporting up to 120 kg.

Battery and Power System

The 60V 30Ah lithium-ion battery, built with LG-M50LT-21700 cells, provides 1.8 kWh of stored energy. This configuration delivers consistent voltage output and reduced heat buildup during heavy use. The dual-motor layout ensures responsive acceleration and strong climbing power, ideal for riders needing sustained performance across both city streets and longer routes. Efficient battery management preserves cycle life while maintaining steady power delivery under high loads.

Performance and Range

The Compact’s dual 1700W motors generate quick launches and high torque, supporting uphill gradients and maintaining top speed under stress. Its range of up to 100 km allows for full-day riding with minimal recharging. A dual charging system reduces downtime, making it a practical choice for daily commuters and long-distance riders alike.

Frame and Design

Built around a precision-welded aluminum chassis, the Compact maintains structural integrity while minimizing weight. The frame design distributes mass evenly for balanced handling. The folding mechanism locks securely, allowing simple storage and transport. The scooter’s clean, streamlined appearance reflects its functional, performance-oriented design.

Suspension and Tires

The suspension system utilizes front and rear rubber cartridges to deliver effective vibration absorption across uneven surfaces. Combined with 8-inch solid tires, this setup eliminates puncture concerns while maintaining traction and grip. The geometry ensures a low center of gravity, improving cornering stability and ride comfort.

Braking and Safety

Dual drum brakes paired with electronic ABS and regenerative EBS form a robust braking system. Mechanical reliability is complemented by electronic precision, reducing braking distance and improving control during emergency stops. Regenerative braking extends range slightly by recovering power during deceleration.

Controls and Interface

The scooter features the EY3 display and control interface, connected to the Dualtron App for live tracking of speed, voltage, and temperature data. Handlebar-mounted controls manage headlights, indicators, and horn. The user interface provides clear visibility even under bright sunlight, enhancing operational safety.

Lighting and Visibility

Front LED headlights, rear brake lights, and integrated side reflectors ensure visibility in all light conditions. The lighting system is optimized for low energy draw while maintaining brightness and safety compliance. This makes the Compact ready for both night commutes and early-morning rides.

Durability and Build Quality

All components of the Dualtron Compact are sealed for protection against dust and light moisture. The deck features an anti-slip silicone surface for stability under wet conditions. Reinforced stem joints and internal wiring channels further extend the scooter’s service life while simplifying maintenance.

Handling and Ride Dynamics

The Compact’s lightweight 32 kg frame, dual-motor powertrain, and tuned suspension system produce confident handling and responsive steering. Its 120 kg load capacity allows for varied riding styles without compromising control. The precise throttle mapping enables linear acceleration across all speeds.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Compact 2025 60V 30Ah stands as one of the most capable mid-weight scooters in its class. Delivering 3400W of dual-motor power, 100 km range, and robust LG battery performance in a portable 32 kg frame, it combines practicality with unmistakable Dualtron engineering. A perfect match for riders who demand both compactness and uncompromised performance.

title: DUALTRON MINI SPECIAL LONG BODY SINGLE MOTOR 52V 13Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 13Ah

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 13Ah delivers strong single-motor performance in a durable, lightweight frame. Powered by a 52V 13Ah battery using CHINA 2600 cells, it produces 900W nominal power with peaks up to 1450W. It reaches speeds of 55 km/h (35 mph) and covers up to 40 km (25 mi) per charge, providing smooth power delivery and stable handling for everyday riders.

Power and Battery System

The 52V system with a 13Ah battery provides 0.6 kWh of energy, ensuring efficient current flow and consistent acceleration. The single BLDC hub motor supplies reliable torque for urban commuting, short trips, and moderate inclines. Maximum rider capacity is 90 kg, while the scooter’s total weight remains 30 kg for easy transport and storage.

Design and Frame Construction

The Long Body edition features a reinforced aluminum frame and an extended deck for improved stability and comfort. The deck surface is covered with a silicone non-slip layer that improves traction and resists wear better than traditional grip tape. Its updated build provides a stronger folding column and smoother structural rigidity for daily use.

Ride Quality and Suspension

Equipped with a dual suspension system using front and rear spring-rubber components, the scooter absorbs road impact efficiently. Combined with 9-inch hybrid tubeless tires, it delivers a steady, vibration-dampened ride on both pavement and rough surfaces.

Braking and Safety

Front and rear drum brakes provide stable stopping performance with balanced braking pressure. The electronic braking system adds regenerative efficiency and prevents wheel lock during sudden stops. This dual setup ensures safety and control across different terrains and weather conditions.

Lighting and Visibility

The Mini 2025 includes a bright LED headlight and rear brake light for nighttime visibility. Reflectors mounted on both sides of the suspension arms improve lateral awareness. The lighting angle is adjustable, ensuring forward illumination without glare for oncoming traffic.

Controls and Interface

The EY3 digital display provides real-time data such as speed, mileage, and voltage. Connected via Bluetooth to the Dualtron App, it allows control over lighting effects, ride modes, and diagnostics. The water-resistant throttle supports five power levels and features clear readability under sunlight or rain.

Folding and Portability

The improved folding column and handlebar mechanism reduce play while maintaining fast folding speed. Foldable grips simplify storage, and the reinforced locking pins extend hinge life. At 30 kg, the scooter remains manageable for lifting or placement in compact spaces.

Durability and Protection

The IPX5-rated construction shields internal electronics from moisture and dust. The charging port uses insulated connectors to prevent corrosion and arcing. Cable management and reinforced joints enhance long-term reliability under frequent use.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Mini 2025 Long Body Single Motor 52V 13Ah combines portability and power in one efficient package. With 55 km/h top speed, 40 km range, and proven build quality, it offers a reliable and practical solution for riders seeking a compact yet powerful electric scooter for urban travel and short-distance commuting.

title: DUALTRON NEW VICTOR LUXURY 60V 30Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Victor Luxury 2025 60V 30Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Victor Luxury 2025 elevates the Victor series with more endurance, refined control, and balanced performance. Featuring dual 4300W motors and a 60V 30Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery, it delivers the ideal mix of torque, speed, and range for demanding riders. Designed with the NEW EY3 display, it blends proven engineering with modern connectivity and practical elegance.

Power and Performance

Equipped with dual BLDC hub motors producing a combined peak power of 4300W, the Victor Luxury accelerates quickly and maintains high efficiency at speed. Its 60V electrical system provides steady torque for uphill climbs and strong responsiveness on flat terrain. Capable of reaching up to 85 km/h, it performs confidently across all environments.

Battery and Range

The 60V 30Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery ensures dependable energy output and long life. With a 1.8 kWh capacity, riders can expect up to 90 km of range under optimal conditions. The built-in BMS protects the cells from overcurrent and heat buildup, maintaining consistent discharge even under heavy use. Dual charging ports allow for faster recovery times between rides.

Display and Control

The upgraded NEW EY3 display keeps critical information visible with high contrast and accurate readouts for voltage, speed, and remaining range. Its interface integrates with the Minimotors system, giving the rider access to settings such as regenerative braking strength, acceleration curve, and ride modes. Simple, intuitive, and reliable.

Build and Structure

The Victor Luxury’s frame is built from high-grade aluminum alloy, achieving an optimal balance between rigidity and weight. At 40 kg, it provides solid stability while remaining portable enough for transport and storage. The reinforced folding mechanism ensures structural integrity during high-speed use or frequent folding.

Suspension and Ride Quality

Dual adjustable cartridge suspension delivers controlled damping across urban roads or uneven surfaces. The 10-inch pneumatic tires work in tandem with the suspension to reduce vibration, enhance grip, and improve comfort. This design makes the Victor Luxury equally suited for performance riding and daily commuting.

Braking and Safety

Hydraulic disc brakes provide sharp, reliable stopping power with precise modulation. Combined with regenerative braking, the system enhances safety while recovering small amounts of energy during deceleration. The stable chassis design and balanced weight distribution improve control under hard braking.

Lighting and Visibility

Front and rear LED lights ensure visibility during night rides, supported by additional deck and side lighting. These enhance both safety and the scooter’s refined appearance, making it visible from all angles while maintaining minimal energy draw from the main battery.

Design and Finish

Every line of the Victor Luxury reflects Dualtron’s focus on function and aesthetics. The clean deck layout, illuminated accents, and compact folding geometry define its premium presentation. The attention to finish and cable integration results in a minimal, professional aesthetic that complements its power.

Handling and Control

The scooter’s geometry, wide handlebars, and responsive throttle provide steady control at all speeds. Smooth steering and weight balance make it comfortable for extended rides, while its low deck height enhances cornering stability and rider confidence.

Durability and Maintenance

The Victor Luxury is engineered for reliability, with internal cabling, sealed connectors, and accessible service points for brake pads, suspension, and tires. Its construction reduces vibration fatigue and wear, ensuring consistent performance over time with minimal maintenance.

In the Box

Includes standard charger, power cable, user manual, and tool kit. Optional accessories such as a fast charger, seat mount, and waterproof mat are available separately.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Victor Luxury 2025 60V 30Ah combines a 4300W dual motor setup with premium build quality and the reliability of LG-M50LT-21700 cells. With its NEW EY3 interface, hydraulic brakes, and refined suspension, it stands as one of the most balanced Dualtron scooters delivering powerful acceleration, strong range, and unmistakable Dualtron craftsmanship.

title: DUALTRON POP SINGLE MOTOR 52V 25Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Pop 2025 Single Motor 52V 25Ah

The Dualtron Pop 2025 Single Motor 52V 25Ah is built for riders who value extended range and dependable performance in a compact frame. It runs on a 52V 25Ah battery using high-quality LG-50LT-21700 cells, providing stable power output and long-term reliability. Its single 1360W hub motor delivers 900W continuous power, achieving speeds up to 55 km/h (35 mph) while maintaining excellent energy efficiency. With a range of up to 75 km (45 mi), the Pop 25Ah is ideal for longer commutes and leisure rides. The 30 kg frame supports up to 90 kg of rider weight, striking an optimal balance between portability and strength.

Battery and Power System

The 1.3 kWh LG-50LT battery ensures steady voltage and high discharge efficiency, maintaining torque under load and extending lifespan across charging cycles. Its 52V system supplies smooth current flow to the motor, resulting in linear acceleration and consistent top-end performance.

Build and Structure

The Pop’s frame is made from reinforced aluminum alloy, offering structural rigidity with low overall weight. A silicone-coated deck provides grip and weather resistance, ensuring stable footing during acceleration and braking. Compact dimensions make it easy to transport and store without compromising on durability.

Suspension and Tires

Dual front and rear suspension systems absorb road vibrations for smoother, more stable handling. The scooter rides on 9-inch tubeless tires, optimized for puncture resistance and traction on urban surfaces, maintaining comfort over uneven terrain.

Braking and Safety

Front and rear drum brakes deliver reliable mechanical stopping power, assisted by an electronic braking system (EBS) that enhances balance and control. The regenerative braking system recycles kinetic energy back into the battery during deceleration, improving overall efficiency.

Lighting and Visibility

The integrated lighting package includes a bright LED headlight, rear tail light, and reflective side markers. These improve visibility for both rider and nearby traffic during night rides. The components meet IPX5 standards for water resistance, ensuring safe use in light rain.

Display and Connectivity

The EY3 digital display shows speed, battery status, and trip data at a glance. Through the Dualtron App, riders can fine-tune acceleration profiles, light settings, and monitor voltage levels. The display’s waterproof design ensures functionality in all weather conditions.

Folding and Portability

The reinforced folding system features dual clamps and thicker locking pins, enhancing steering precision and structural reliability. Foldable handlebars make it compact for car transport or indoor storage. At 30 kg, it remains light enough for frequent folding and carrying.

Durability and Maintenance

Upgraded charging ports, sealed connectors, and IPX5-rated electronics increase resistance to water and dust. The simple mechanical layout allows easy access to key components for maintenance and replacement, making it a dependable long-term choice for daily commuting.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Pop 2025 Single Motor 52V 25Ah delivers a top speed of 35 mph, a 45 mi range, and smooth control in a solid, portable 30 kg frame. Backed by LG cell reliability and Dualtron’s signature engineering, it’s a powerful yet practical electric scooter for riders seeking endurance, speed, and simplicity.

title: DUALTRON NEW CITY 60V 25Ah
body_html:
Dualtron New City 60V 25Ah – Power, Comfort, and Range in One Urban Machine

The Dualtron New City 2025 is built for riders who demand strength, stability, and all-terrain capability. Equipped with a 60V system and dual hub motors delivering 4000W of total output, it offers confident performance for both city commutes and extended touring. Designed by Minimotors and refined for the European market, this version integrates durability, safety, and improved ride comfort into one of Dualtron’s most versatile scooters.

Performance and Power Delivery

The twin-motor setup provides instant torque and smooth acceleration, ideal for mixed riding conditions from dense traffic to long open roads. Enhanced controller tuning ensures efficient power distribution and greater responsiveness when climbing or overtaking. The balance between power and range makes the New City 2025 one of the most adaptable scooters in the Dualtron lineup.

Battery System and Range

The 60V 25Ah battery built with LG-M50LT-21700 cells provides consistent power and long life. The removable battery design allows convenient charging in smaller spaces without needing to move the entire scooter indoors, while also simplifying maintenance and replacement.

Charging Convenience

The New City 2025 supports standard and fast charging through insulated, rubber-covered ports. The battery management system regulates charging temperature and voltage for safety and long-term cell protection.

Build and Design

The scooter’s large frame and reinforced folding column deliver exceptional stability at high speed. Wide deck space and low center of gravity improve comfort during longer rides, while the alloy frame combines structural strength with practical portability.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

Front and rear suspension arms provide extended travel for improved shock absorption. Combined with 15-inch pneumatic tires, this setup ensures smoother rolling, higher stability, and better traction on uneven surfaces.

Safety and Braking

The Dualtron New City 2025 uses Nutt hydraulic dual-piston brakes for controlled and reliable stopping performance. Large disc rotors improve heat dissipation, ensuring consistent braking under repeated use and demanding riding conditions.

Lighting and Visibility

Integrated lighting includes under-deck RGB lights, side illumination, and mudguard lighting to improve visibility. The main headlight provides strong forward projection, while indicators and rear brake lights enhance safety in traffic.

Technology and Control

EY4 Display and App Integration

The New City comes equipped with the EY4 display, offering improved interface clarity, Bluetooth connectivity and app integration. Riders can monitor speed, battery and ride data in real time while adjusting settings such as speed modes, lighting and security features directly from the display or mobile app.

Practicality and Folding

Despite its large size, the New City 2025 remains practical thanks to its foldable steering column and handlebars. The folding system allows compact storage and transport, while maintaining rigidity when locked in riding position.

Design Details and Aesthetics

The 15-inch alloy wheels with six-spoke design define the scooter’s visual identity. RGB lighting integrated along suspension arms enhances visibility and gives a modern appearance, complemented by clean cable routing and matte finish.

Durability and Maintenance

Reinforced joints and improved waterproofing protect critical components. The modular deck and removable battery enclosure allow easier access for servicing and cleaning, supporting long-term usability.

In the Box

Each Dualtron New City 2025 includes a standard charger, charging cable, user manual, and Minimotors multi-tool kit. Optional accessories such as fast charger and seat kit are available separately.

Conclusion

The Dualtron New City 2025 combines dual motor power, large-wheel stability and modern EY4 technology into a practical high-performance scooter. With removable battery convenience, hydraulic braking and enhanced control systems, it delivers a balanced solution for urban mobility and extended riding.

title: DUALTRON X2-UP 72V 45Ah
body_html:
Dualtron X2-UP 2025 | 72V 45Ah | 8300W Dual Motor

The Dualtron X2-UP 2025 represents the evolution of high-performance electric mobility, engineered for speed, distance, and control. With dual 8300W motors and a 72V 45Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery, it delivers remarkable acceleration, long-range endurance, and the torque needed to dominate any terrain. Built with precision, it offers riders a 150 km range and top speeds reaching 110 km/h, defining the standard for ultra-long-range electric scooters.

Power and Range

The X2-UP’s 72V system ensures optimal energy efficiency and powerful torque output across all speed ranges. Its 3.2 kWh LG battery provides up to 150 km of riding distance per charge, sustaining voltage even under full load. The scooter’s 8300W dual hub motors enable rapid acceleration and effortless hill climbing while maintaining consistent performance for extended rides.

Design and Construction

Weighing 66 kg, the X2-UP’s reinforced frame uses aviation-grade aluminum alloy for high strength and reduced flex. The extended wheelbase and wide deck enhance ride stability at high speeds, while a load capacity of 120 kg ensures suitability for a wide range of riders. Its structural rigidity and high ground clearance make it equally competent on urban roads or off-road paths.

Suspension and Comfort

The advanced adjustable hydraulic suspension system absorbs vibrations and shocks effectively, maintaining traction and comfort at all speeds. Combined with large 13-inch tubeless tires, it delivers precise handling and smooth ride dynamics on uneven terrain. This system adapts naturally to both high-speed performance and relaxed cruising.

Braking and Safety

Equipped with hydraulic four-piston brakes and ventilated rotors, the X2-UP provides stable, powerful braking control. Electronic braking and ABS ensure balanced deceleration, while regenerative braking feeds power back to the battery, extending ride range and brake lifespan. The result is consistent safety and confidence even during aggressive riding.

Lighting and Control

The integrated EY4 color LCD display shows speed, voltage, and real-time diagnostics, with Bluetooth connectivity for the Minimotors app. Riders can customize throttle response, lights, and braking sensitivity. High-intensity LED headlights, RGB side lights, and tail illumination guarantee full visibility day or night, combining style with safety.

Performance and Handling

The X2-UP’s dual motor system operates independently through dual 40A controllers, delivering precise throttle response and linear torque output. Its aerodynamic design minimizes drag while improving cooling efficiency for sustained top-end performance. Even at 70 mph (110 km/h), the scooter remains composed, agile, and controllable.

Durability and Maintenance

The X2-UP features a modular chassis that simplifies servicing, with easy access to controller, battery, and wiring components. IPX5-rated waterproofing protects electronics from dust and moisture, ensuring long-term reliability. Dual charging ports enable faster recharging with optional fast chargers, reducing downtime between rides.

Comfort and Practicality

The wide deck with anti-slip silicone coating offers stability and comfort on long rides. Ergonomic handlebars and optimized handle geometry provide better leverage during acceleration or braking. Despite its size, the scooter folds compactly for transport or storage when necessary.

Conclusion

The Dualtron X2-UP 2025 delivers 8300W of raw power, a 72V 45Ah LG battery, and 150 km of range in a refined, durable design. With hydraulic suspension, four-piston brakes, smart EY4 controls, and 110 km/h performance, it represents the perfect balance of speed, stability, and endurance. Built for experienced riders, it stands as a premium long-range machine for those who demand top-tier performance and reliability.

title: DUALTRON NEW VICTOR LUXURY PLUS 60V 35Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus 2025 60V 35Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus 2025 stands at the top of the Victor line, combining refined power delivery, extended range, and advanced control. Equipped with a 60V 35Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery, it stores a total of 2.1 kWh of usable energy. This battery system powers dual BLDC hub motors that produce a combined output of 4300W, delivering both strong torque and consistent high-speed performance up to 85 km/h (50 mph). Despite its capability, the scooter maintains a well-balanced frame at 37 kg, optimized to carry riders up to 100 kg.

Performance and Power

Operating on a 60V platform, the Victor Luxury Plus ensures efficient current flow to its 4300W dual-motor system. The motors deliver rapid acceleration and smooth throttle response, whether climbing hills or cruising at top speed. With its advanced controller setup, the scooter maintains power stability even under high load, providing predictable handling and precise control through all ride conditions. The torque curve allows strong pull from standstill without sacrificing range efficiency.

Battery and Range

The 60V 35Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery defines the scooter’s endurance. Built for long rides, it can travel up to 90 km (55 miles) on a single charge. Its high-density cells ensure steady voltage under heavy output, while the integrated BMS protects against overcurrent, overheating, and deep discharge. Dual charging ports allow faster recharging with compatible chargers, enabling riders to regain energy in half the standard time. The large 2.1 kWh capacity makes it ideal for urban commuting and extended weekend journeys alike.

Design and Build Quality

The Victor Luxury Plus is constructed from aerospace-grade aluminum alloy, balancing strength and weight. At 37 kg, it remains manageable for loading or lifting while offering a sturdy ride at speed. Every joint and hinge is reinforced, including the folding mechanism, which uses a thicker double clamp for improved rigidity. This design minimizes flex, even under hard acceleration, preserving stability and rider confidence. The low deck position contributes to a lower center of gravity and better cornering dynamics.

Display and Connectivity

The new EY4 display introduces a full-color waterproof interface that connects via Bluetooth to the Dualtron app. Riders can adjust acceleration curves, regenerative braking levels, and speed modes directly through the display or smartphone. Real-time diagnostics provide voltage readings, fault codes, and temperature data, enhancing both safety and tuning flexibility. The system also supports ride history logging and PIN-based locking for anti-theft protection.

Ride and Suspension

The scooter uses front and rear adjustable cartridge suspension systems tuned for both comfort and precision. Each unit absorbs road imperfections while maintaining wheel contact and balance. Combined with 10-inch pneumatic tires, the suspension gives a fluid ride across urban, suburban, and semi-off-road surfaces. The deck is wide and grippy, allowing stable footing even at higher speeds or rough terrain transitions.

Braking and Safety

Dual hydraulic disc brakes ensure reliable, progressive stopping power. The system is responsive under light pressure and remains steady during emergency braking. Regenerative braking supplements the hydraulics, capturing kinetic energy to extend range while reducing pad wear. This combined setup provides consistent deceleration with minimal fade, crucial for a 4300W dual-motor machine capable of 85 km/h performance.

Lighting and Visibility

The Victor Luxury Plus integrates LED headlights, tail lights, and deck-edge lighting for improved visibility. The illumination system draws minimal power yet produces strong brightness for night rides. Reflective details and side lights make the scooter visible from multiple angles, enhancing safety in dense traffic and low-light environments.

Handling and Comfort

With wide handlebars, a centered riding position, and smooth throttle response, the Victor Luxury Plus feels planted and predictable. The 60V system’s even power distribution supports balanced traction between front and rear motors, improving corner control. The low deck height aids maneuverability, while the combination of 37 kg mass and rigid frame keeps vibration low at high speed.

Craftsmanship and Longevity

All wiring and connectors are sealed for moisture protection, ensuring reliable operation over time. The LG-M50LT-21700 cells maintain consistent discharge characteristics over hundreds of charge cycles. Components like the braking system, folding joints, and tires are easy to service, extending the scooter’s long-term usability. The build reflects Minimotors’ focus on combining mechanical precision with electrical reliability.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Victor Luxury Plus 2025 60V 35Ah redefines midweight performance by integrating high-density LG cells, dual 4300W motors, and an intelligent EY4 control system into a refined, 37 kg platform. With its 85 km/h top speed, 90 km range, and balanced chassis, it offers both endurance and excitement. Every element from suspension to electronics serves to deliver a powerful, efficient, and connected riding experience built to Dualtron’s highest standards.

title: DUALTRON NEW ACHILLEUS 60V 35Ah (BLACK)
body_html:
Dualtron Achilleus 2025 – The Next Generation of Power and Precision

The Dualtron Achilleus 2025 60V 35Ah marks a major step forward in the evolution of high-performance electric scooters. Designed by Minimotors and distributed by Scootera Ltd in the UK, this new version takes everything riders loved about the Achilleus and refines it with more stability, connectivity, and safety for everyday and long-distance riding.

Performance and Riding Dynamics

The Achilleus 2025 delivers instant torque and smooth acceleration across all terrains. Its improved controller system provides responsive power management, giving riders full control from low-speed cruising to high-speed touring. The balanced chassis and wide deck maintain superior grip and handling, making it ideal for both city commutes and open-road adventures.

What’s New in the 2025 Edition

Enhanced Braking System

The 2025 model upgrades to Nutt hydraulic disc brakes, replacing the previous Zoom system. This provides a firmer brake feel, shorter stopping distances, and improved modulation in wet conditions.

Upgraded Display and Controls

The new waterproof EY4 display integrates seamlessly with the Minimotors App, giving real-time data and full control over speed limits, lights, and ride settings. A 4-digit security PIN adds anti-theft protection. The left-hand multi-switch now handles headlight, indicators, and horn, while the right-hand single/dual motor button allows quick power toggling on the move.

Improved Steering and Stability

The Achilleus adopts a 3-bolt steering column system that increases rigidity and eliminates play in the folding mechanism. This delivers safer handling at higher speeds and improved long-term durability.

Lighting and Visibility

A new 30W LED headlight ensures strong forward visibility, while RGB accent lights illuminate the side arms, deck, and steering column. These synchronized lights not only enhance safety but also give the Achilleus a distinctive night-time look.

Handlebar and Comfort Upgrades

The handlebar has been extended by 10 cm for better ergonomics and stability. The new illuminated footrest integrates a tail light and brake light, improving visibility from the rear while offering better foot placement for long rides.

Safety and Comfort

The adjustable cartridge suspension absorbs road imperfections effectively, allowing riders to tune stiffness for their weight or terrain. The silicone-coated deck provides excellent traction in all weather conditions. The reinforced kickstand keeps the scooter stable even on uneven ground, and the extended handlebar geometry enhances cornering control.

Build Quality and Materials

The 2025 Achilleus maintains its full-size frame built from aviation-grade aluminum alloy. The wide platform and strong joint reinforcements give it long-term reliability. Design improvements include repositioned screws above the battery compartment for safer maintenance and cleaner internal cable management, reducing wear and improving service access.

Technology and Connectivity

Through the Minimotors App, the EY4 display connects via Bluetooth for complete scooter diagnostics and customization. Riders can set speed modes, lighting patterns, and check mileage or temperature data. Ownership registration and anti-theft features protect the scooter both physically and digitally.

Battery and Charging

Available with premium LG-M50LT-21700 cells, the Achilleus 2025 offers efficient energy delivery and consistent power output. Enhanced charging ports now feature rubber covers and insulation for better water resistance and user safety. Dual charging compatibility allows faster recharge times when using compatible chargers.

Design and Aesthetics

The Achilleus retains its bold design language with a clean, muscular silhouette. The illuminated deck logo, RGB accent lines, and matte black finish emphasize its performance-oriented look. The new footrest, side covers, and steering details bring refinement without adding unnecessary weight.

Included Accessories

Every unit comes with a standard charger, power cable, Minimotors multi-tool set, and nut caps. Optional accessories such as a fast charger and detachable seat are available for extended comfort or range-focused rides.

Riding Experience

Whether used for daily commutes or long weekend rides, the Achilleus 2025 balances aggression and control. The dual-motor system, wide tires, and refined suspension ensure a confident, planted ride even on rough surfaces. The combination of lighting, app connectivity, and structural upgrades make it one of the most complete scooters in the Dualtron lineup.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Achilleus 2025 redefines what a high-performance electric scooter should be. With smarter electronics, stronger mechanics, and enhanced safety, it delivers a professional-grade riding experience that stands at the top of the Dualtron range.

title: DUALTRON RAPTOR 2 60V 14Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Raptor 2 2025 Dual Motor 60V 14Ah

The Dualtron Raptor 2 2025 is engineered for riders who want power and portability in one compact form. Running on a 60V 14Ah CHINA 2000 battery, it delivers smooth energy efficiency and strong torque across its dual 1500W hub motors, producing a combined output of 3000W. This setup achieves speeds of up to 65 km/h (40 mph) while maintaining excellent stability. With a range of 50 km (30 mi) per charge, the Raptor 2 offers dependable commuting range and weekend-ready performance. At only 22 kg, it combines lightweight design with genuine Dualtron power.

Battery and Performance

The 60V system provides consistent output and strong acceleration. The 0.8 kWh battery ensures quick discharge efficiency without overheating, delivering reliable energy over time. Dual hub motors evenly distribute power across both wheels, improving traction and climb ability on steep roads.

Design and Structure

The Raptor 2’s aluminum alloy frame maximizes strength while keeping overall weight low. Its compact long-body layout supports comfortable stance and easy maneuverability. Silicone-coated deck covering offers extra grip and weather resistance, maintaining performance across conditions.

Suspension and Tires

Front and rear spring suspension absorb road shocks efficiently, creating a smoother, more stable ride. Fitted with 8-inch solid tires, the Raptor 2 eliminates puncture risk and reduces maintenance while maintaining reliable grip for urban environments.

Braking and Safety

Equipped with dual drum brakes and an electronic braking system (EBS), the scooter ensures smooth, controlled deceleration. The braking setup offers confident control even at higher speeds, enhancing both safety and ride comfort.

Display and Controls

The EY3 throttle display shows speed, voltage, trip data, and battery percentage with precision. Connected through the Dualtron App, it allows riders to adjust acceleration profiles, cruise control, and lighting preferences, ensuring a personalized riding experience.

Lighting and Visibility

Integrated LED headlight, tail light, and turn indicators enhance visibility during day and night rides. Reflective side markers improve rider safety in traffic. All lighting components are built to IPX5 standards for water resistance and durability.

Folding and Portability

The folding mechanism includes reinforced clamps and locking pins, allowing secure folding for transport or storage. At just 22 kg, the Raptor 2 is easy to carry and store in compact spaces, making it an ideal commuter scooter for urban mobility.

Build Quality and Maintenance

Sealed connectors and protected charging ports minimize wear from dust and moisture. The modular internal layout allows for quick service access, keeping maintenance efficient. Its solid-tire configuration further reduces upkeep needs.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Raptor 2 2025 Dual Motor 60V 14Ah combines 40 mph top speed, 30 mi range, and a lightweight 22 kg build. With solid tires, dual braking, and proven Dualtron engineering, it’s a dependable, compact scooter for daily riders who want performance without compromise.

title: DUALTRON NEW STORM 72V 35Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Storm 2025 72V 35Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Storm 2025 represents the next generation of ultra-performance electric scooters, combining raw power, advanced electronics, and long-distance capability. Built around a 72V 35Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery system and dual 6640W hub motors, it delivers the perfect balance between endurance and acceleration. The Storm 2025 is engineered for riders seeking maximum power, high speed, and long-range performance without sacrificing stability or comfort.

Performance and Power

Equipped with dual brushless hub motors producing a combined 6640W output, the Storm 2025 achieves a top speed of approximately 90 km/h. The scooter’s 72V system ensures rapid acceleration and consistent torque delivery even under demanding conditions. Riders experience smooth power modulation through improved motor controllers optimized for thermal stability and response. The overall structure supports a maximum load of 100 kg while maintaining superior balance and ride dynamics.

Battery System and Range

The 72V 35Ah battery pack, built with LG-M50LT-21700 cells, provides up to 150 km of range per charge depending on riding mode and terrain. Designed with high energy density and low internal resistance, this battery system ensures efficient power transfer and stable voltage output throughout the ride. Its enhanced thermal design improves safety and battery life during extended use. The charging system supports dual chargers, reducing charging time when needed.

EY4 Display and App Integration

The new waterproof EY4 display improves visibility under all lighting conditions. It connects directly to the Minimotors app, giving riders access to live data such as speed, voltage, range, and controller temperature. App integration also enables security PIN setup, ride statistics tracking, and firmware updates. The digital interface replaces older throttle systems, providing a more responsive and intuitive user experience.

Build and Construction

The Dualtron Storm 2025 uses a reinforced aluminum alloy frame and extended platform design to increase strength and stability. The low center of gravity improves control during acceleration and braking. Despite its 45 kg total weight, the scooter folds efficiently for transport and storage. The reinforced hinge and triple-bolt steering column improve durability under heavy riding conditions, maintaining precise steering feel even at high speeds.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

Front and rear suspension systems feature adjustable cartridges designed to handle both urban roads and off-road terrain. The longer wheelbase and wide deck enhance stability at top speed, while improved vibration damping increases rider comfort. The wide tires absorb shocks effectively, giving the Storm 2025 a planted, controlled ride on various surfaces.

Braking and Safety

Dual hydraulic disc brakes with integrated electronic braking ensure powerful and controlled deceleration. The balanced braking system improves safety at high speeds and prevents wheel lock. Reflectors and integrated LED lighting on both front and rear improve visibility in low-light conditions, ensuring that the Storm 2025 remains as safe as it is fast.

Lighting and Visibility

The integrated LED headlight, taillight, and side accent lights provide maximum visibility. The lighting system is optimized for both day and night use, enhancing both safety and design appeal. The under-deck and side RGB lighting can be customized through the Minimotors app, adding personalization to the overall setup.

Design and Practical Features

The removable battery module simplifies maintenance and allows for external charging. The wide foot platform offers ample standing space for comfort during long rides. Improved cable management and insulation protect the electronics from moisture and vibration, ensuring reliability through extended operation.

Technology and Control System

The Storm 2025 integrates an advanced control interface that synchronizes display data with app functions. Through the EY4 display, riders can adjust speed limits, throttle response, and regenerative braking levels. Real-time performance metrics and fault diagnostics improve monitoring and safety management.

In the Box

Each Dualtron Storm 2025 includes a standard charger, power cable, user manual, nut caps, and tool kit. Optional accessories such as a fast charger, seat kit, and deck cover are available separately for extended comfort and customization.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Storm 2025 redefines what a high-performance electric scooter can achieve. With dual 6640W motors, a 72V 35Ah LG battery, hydraulic brakes, and the advanced EY4 app display, it combines speed, range, and control in a single package. Whether for high-speed touring or long-range commuting, the Storm 2025 delivers unmatched power, precision, and ride confidence in the premium scooter segment.

title: DUALTRON NEW STORM LTD 84V 45Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Storm LTD 2025 84V 45Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Storm LTD 2025 redefines electric scooter performance with its unmatched 11,000W dual motor system, advanced EY4 display, and 84V 45Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery pack. Designed for professionals and enthusiasts, it offers extreme torque, high-speed stability, and record-breaking range while maintaining the signature reliability of the Dualtron lineup.

Power and Performance

Equipped with dual BLDC hub motors producing 11,000W peak output, the Storm LTD accelerates with authority and sustains a top speed of 100 km/h. The 84V powertrain delivers intense torque response for both city and open-road riding. The 45Ah battery ensures up to 220 km of range per charge, providing industry-leading endurance for long-distance riders.

Battery System and Efficiency

The LG-M50LT-21700 cell configuration provides a total capacity of 3.8 kWh, maintaining consistent discharge rates and superior thermal stability. Its integrated Battery Management System (BMS) optimizes charging and safeguards against overcurrent and overheating. With support for dual fast chargers, the Storm LTD minimizes downtime between rides while preserving battery life.

EY4 Display and App Integration

The new EY4 display enhances rider control and visibility through its high-resolution color interface. Fully compatible with the Minimotors app, it allows detailed monitoring of speed, voltage, and temperature along with adjustable ride settings and security features. Riders can register their scooter, set PIN locks, and customize performance modes directly from their smartphone.

Frame Design and Structural Upgrades

The Storm LTD 2025 introduces a third-generation folding system for improved rigidity and easier handling. The thicker steering column and reinforced folding clamps ensure stability during acceleration and braking. The integrated controller housing located within the footrest enhances heat dissipation and protects the electronics from external impact and vibration.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

The adjustable suspension system offers multiple stiffness levels to match rider preference and road conditions. The dual-spring architecture combined with polyurethane inserts improves shock absorption and traction. This setup allows for a comfortable ride over rough terrain without sacrificing responsiveness or control.

Braking and Safety

Four-piston hydraulic brakes provide powerful, precise stopping performance. The braking system is complemented by regenerative electronic braking, reducing wear and improving control at high speed. The scooter’s large contact-patch tires increase grip during deceleration, further enhancing safety.

Lighting and Visibility

Dual front LED headlights, integrated brake lights, turn indicators, and under-deck RGB accent lighting ensure full visibility. The lighting configuration improves nighttime awareness while adding a distinctive Dualtron aesthetic. All lighting functions are accessible from the left-hand multi-switch control.

Tires and Wheel Configuration

The Storm LTD features tubeless 12-inch tires compatible with PMT racing-grade replacements. This design provides greater puncture resistance, improved heat dispersion, and more precise road feedback, supporting high-speed stability and confidence during aggressive riding.

Waterproofing and Deck Design

The waterproof silicone deck provides excellent grip and durability under wet or dusty conditions. It protects electrical components while simplifying cleaning and maintenance. The scooter achieves a high level of weather resistance, suitable for multi-season use.

Convenience and Control

The EY4 interface integrates with a new multi-switch module controlling horn, lights, and indicators. Riders can toggle functions without removing their hand from the handlebar. The upgraded kickstand offers better stability, while insulated charging ports prevent arcing during high-current charging sessions.

Security and Anti-Theft Measures

App registration and pairing are required to unlock full scooter functions, enhancing anti-theft protection. Upcoming firmware upgrades will introduce advanced lockout features for improved user security. Combined with the integrated EY4 PIN lock system, the Storm LTD ensures that ownership and access remain secure.

Build Quality and Dimensions

Weighing 50 kg and supporting up to 100 kg load, the Storm LTD maintains excellent weight distribution for optimal control. Its aluminum alloy frame resists flex at high speed and is built to withstand extreme riding conditions, making it suitable for both performance touring and professional-level use.

In the Box

Each Dualtron Storm LTD 2025 includes a standard charger, power cable, multi-tool set, user manual, and nut caps. Optional accessories such as fast charger, seat kit, and deck mat are available for customization.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Storm LTD 2025 stands as the ultimate expression of Minimotors engineering. With an 11,000W motor system, 84V 45Ah LG battery, advanced EY4 control unit, and race-ready suspension, it pushes the boundaries of performance and technology. Built for demanding riders, it delivers extreme speed, superior range, and precision control making it the pinnacle of the Dualtron lineup.

title: DUALTRON ULTRA 2 UPGRADE 72V 40Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Ultra 2 Upgrade 2025 | 72V 40Ah | 6640W Dual Motor

The Dualtron Ultra 2 Upgrade 2025 marks a new era in high-performance electric mobility. Built around a 72V powertrain and dual 6640W motors, it delivers explosive acceleration, refined control, and long-distance capability. Powered by an LG-M50LT-21700 40Ah battery, it achieves up to 120 km of range and a top speed of 95 km/h, positioning it among the most capable off-road scooters ever built by Minimotors.

Power and Range

At its core lies a 2.9 kWh battery that maintains steady discharge under extreme load, ensuring continuous torque output across the entire ride. The dual motor configuration pushes 6640W peak power, conquering steep inclines and maintaining high speeds with minimal loss in performance. Riders can expect up to 120 km of real-world range on moderate terrain or around 75 mi at mixed throttle, depending on load and riding conditions.

Frame and Build

Constructed from aircraft-grade aluminum alloy, the Ultra 2 Upgrade’s 45 kg frame offers unmatched rigidity and durability. The reinforced neck and stem use a dual-clamp folding system that eliminates flex, enhancing precision at speed. Despite its solid build, it remains manageable for transport, folding compactly for easier storage or vehicle loading.

Suspension and Ride Comfort

Minimotors integrates an elastomer torsion suspension system that adapts to rider weight and terrain. This setup absorbs sharp impacts without losing responsiveness, delivering a smooth and controlled ride across dirt, gravel, or asphalt. The front elastomer module improves steering feedback and stability, while the rear torsion system reduces fatigue on longer rides.

Braking and Safety

Equipped with Nutt hydraulic brakes, finned calipers, and ventilated rotors, the scooter ensures powerful braking even under sustained use. Electronic ABS and regenerative braking work in tandem to provide balanced deceleration and extended brake pad life. The system maintains control during abrupt stops, even on steep descents.

Lighting and Visibility

The lighting system features triple front LEDs two white beams and a central amber signal paired with RGB side strips and a deck-mounted rear light for full 360° visibility. The new DC-DC converter consolidates all lighting controls into a single system, simplifying brightness and mode adjustments. Reflective side panels further improve visibility in low-light conditions.

Control and Display

The EY4 smart display brings next-generation connectivity with real-time performance data, temperature readings, and diagnostics. Bluetooth pairing allows integration with the Minimotors app for detailed tuning of throttle sensitivity, regenerative braking, and lighting preferences. A built-in PIN code adds anti-theft protection, while waterproof sealing ensures reliability in rain or dust.

Design Enhancements

The handlebar has been widened for better leverage, while new cable routing reduces strain during steering. A modular deck layout allows quick access to internal wiring for maintenance. The 11-inch off-road tires with split rims simplify tire replacement and improve durability during high-impact use. Ground clearance remains high, giving the scooter strong off-road capability and stability on obstacles under 5 cm.

Riding Experience

With its 72V power system, responsive throttle curve, and precise steering geometry, the Ultra 2 Upgrade offers a refined yet aggressive feel. The silicone-coated deck provides reliable grip even in wet conditions, while the ergonomically curved handlebars reduce wrist fatigue during extended rides. Combined with its 100 kg load capacity, it’s built for both daily commuting and extreme terrain exploration.

Maintenance and Practical Use

The split rim design minimizes service downtime, and the improved kickstand adapted from the Storm LTD offers better stability on uneven surfaces. Dual charging ports allow faster recharging with two chargers, cutting downtime to under 9 hours. IPX5 sealing protects electronics from rain and dust, extending operational life and reliability.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Ultra 2 Upgrade 2025 72V 40Ah represents the pinnacle of electric scooter engineering: 6640W dual motors, 120 km range, 95 km/h top speed, and rugged off-road performance. With an LG-M50LT-21700 battery, EY4 smart control system, advanced suspension, and precision braking, it is a full-scale evolution of the Ultra legacy built for riders who demand endurance, strength, and unrestrained power in one premium machine.

title: DUALTRON SPIDER MAX 60V 24Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Spider 2 2025 | 60V 30Ah (EY4)

The Dualtron Spider 2 2025 combines performance and lightweight engineering for riders seeking maximum efficiency and agility. Powered by a 60V 30Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery pack, it delivers consistent current output and superior energy density. The dual hub motors provide 3600W total power, reaching speeds up to 70 km/h (40 mph) with a range of 100 km (60 mi). Weighing just 26 kg, the Spider 2 retains Dualtron’s signature strength while staying portable and responsive.

Battery and Powertrain

The 1.8 kWh LG-M50LT battery ensures stable voltage and high discharge rates, supporting sustained top-end performance. Dual 1800W motors drive both wheels for improved traction and acceleration, ideal for steep climbs and extended runs. The 60V system enhances efficiency and maintains torque consistency under load.

Frame and Build

The Spider 2’s frame is built from forged aviation-grade aluminum alloy, optimizing strength-to-weight ratio. Its minimalist architecture keeps mass centered for balance and precise control. A non-slip deck and compact stem improve rider confidence while ensuring durability for everyday use.

Ride Comfort and Suspension

Equipped with front and rear suspension, the Spider 2 absorbs bumps and vibrations for smooth handling on variable terrain. The large 10-inch pneumatic tires increase traction and stability while keeping the ride quiet and comfortable during long commutes.

Braking and Safety

Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes provide sharp, responsive stopping power. The system integrates regenerative EBS to recover energy during braking. LED lighting and reflective accents improve rider visibility and safety in low-light conditions.

Display and Connectivity

The EY4 display delivers clear visibility with integrated Bluetooth connectivity and app support. Riders can monitor speed, voltage, range, and temperature in real time, adjusting acceleration, brake response, and light settings through the Dualtron app.

Portability and Usability

With its 26 kg lightweight structure and foldable stem, the Spider 2 is easy to store and transport. Its simple mechanical design allows quick maintenance access while ensuring long-term dependability.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Spider 2 2025 60V 30Ah delivers 3600W power, 70 km/h top speed, and 100 km range in a 26 kg frame. Combining LG battery reliability, precision control, and Dualtron’s advanced design, it redefines performance in the lightweight scooter category.

title: DUALTRON POP DUAL MOTOR 52V 14Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Pop 2025 Dual Motor 52V 14Ah

The Dualtron Pop 2025 Dual Motor 52V 14Ah brings efficient dual-motor performance into a compact and lightweight frame. Powered by two hub motors delivering a combined 1800W continuous output (2700W peak), it reaches speeds of up to 60 km/h (35 mph) while maintaining stable acceleration and torque. A 52V 14Ah battery built with CHINA 21700 cells ensures strong power delivery and consistent runtime, providing a range of up to 40 km (25 mi) per charge.

Battery and Motor Performance

The 52V system optimizes efficiency, keeping voltage drop low and extending motor responsiveness during climbs or fast cruising. The dual BLDC hub motors balance front and rear traction for smoother handling and improved hill-climbing power. The 0.7 kWh battery charges quickly and supports reliable current flow for extended daily use.

Build and Frame Design

The aluminum-alloy frame provides rigidity while keeping total weight at only 24 kg, making the scooter easy to transport. It supports riders up to 90 kg, offering a strong yet compact build ideal for city commuting. The deck features an anti-slip silicone surface for enhanced grip, durability, and simple maintenance.

Ride Quality and Suspension

Front and rear rubber suspension units reduce vibration and improve stability on uneven terrain. Combined with 9-inch tubeless tires, the setup delivers smooth handling, excellent traction, and reduced risk of punctures during everyday use.

Braking and Safety

Dual drum brakes paired with an electronic braking system ensure balanced and reliable stopping performance. The braking response remains consistent across various road conditions, providing safety during high-speed or emergency stops.

Lighting and Visibility

Integrated front and rear LED lights provide visibility in low-light conditions, while side reflectors enhance nighttime safety. The headlight’s position is optimized for broader road coverage without glare interference.

Display and Controls

The EY3 throttle display provides clear real-time readouts for speed, voltage, and mileage. Through the Dualtron App, riders can customize acceleration profiles, light settings, and diagnostics. All components are IPX5 water-resistant for reliable outdoor performance.

Folding and Portability

The improved folding mechanism features reinforced clamps for reduced vibration and better alignment. Foldable handlebars enhance portability, allowing easy storage at home, office, or vehicle transport.

Durability and Protection

Wiring and connectors are upgraded with insulation and strain relief to minimize wear. The IPX5 water-resistance rating protects the scooter from light rain and splashes. The redesigned charging port includes a protective cap to prevent dust and moisture intrusion.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Pop 2025 Dual Motor 52V 14Ah combines compact design with dual-motor power, delivering 35 mph top speed, 25 mi range, and strong durability at 24 kg. It’s the ideal choice for riders seeking lightweight performance and dependable Dualtron engineering in an accessible, everyday format.

title: DUALTRON SPIDER MAX 60V 30Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Spider Max 2025 | 60V 30Ah (EY4)

The Dualtron Spider Max 2025 is the pinnacle of lightweight performance scooters, powered by a 60V 30Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery and dual 2150W hub motors delivering a total of 4300W. Capable of reaching speeds up to 80 km/h (50 mph) and a range of 100 km (60 mi), it balances top-tier performance with everyday portability. Weighing just 30 kg, it supports riders up to 100 kg while maintaining superb handling and stability.

Battery and Power System

The 1.8 kWh LG battery ensures efficient current flow and long cycle life, maintaining power consistency even under heavy acceleration. The 60V system optimizes motor torque, providing smooth, rapid acceleration with steady voltage output across extended rides.

Frame and Build

The Spider Max uses a reinforced aviation-grade aluminum frame, keeping strength high while minimizing overall weight. Its folding mechanism mirrors the premium Storm series, offering solid lock-in precision and quick folding for storage or transport. The matte black finish emphasizes its sleek, functional design.

Ride Comfort and Handling

Equipped with front and rear suspension and 10-inch pneumatic tires, the Spider Max provides a comfortable ride across mixed terrain. The longer deck and optimized center of gravity enhance rider balance, making high-speed cruising smooth and stable.

Lighting and Safety

Dual 30W LED headlights illuminate long paths ahead, supported by integrated turn signals and tail lights positioned on the footrest for better visibility. Side deck LEDs improve presence at night. Dual charging ports with insulation and moisture protection ensure safe, reliable operation.

Controls and Display

The EY4 color display connects via Bluetooth to the Dualtron app, offering advanced customization including throttle response, lighting, and diagnostics. Real-time readouts of speed, voltage, and temperature keep the rider informed and in control.

Braking System

Hydraulic disc brakes paired with regenerative EBS ensure fast and consistent stopping power. The dual braking layout enhances safety during high-speed descents or emergency stops, reducing wear and improving energy recovery efficiency.

Maintenance and Durability

A split rim design simplifies tire replacement, while the detachable rear mudguard makes cleaning and upkeep straightforward. IPX5-rated wiring and sealed connectors protect against dust and light rain for extended reliability.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Spider Max 2025 delivers 4300W power, 80 km/h speed, and 100 km range in a 30 kg chassis. With LG battery technology, hydraulic braking, and EY4 connectivity, it redefines what a lightweight performance scooter can achieve.
