title: DUALTRON THUNDER 3 72V 40Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Thunder 3 2025 | 72V 40Ah (EY4)

The Dualtron Thunder 3 2025 defines premium performance in electric scooters, powered by a 72V 40Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery and dual 5400W hub motors for a total output of 10800W. It reaches speeds up to 100 km/h (60 mph) with an extended range of 170 km (100 mi). Built for riders demanding speed and distance, the Thunder 3 balances raw power with control and efficiency, supporting up to 100 kg of rider weight.

Battery and Power System

The 2.8 kWh LG-M50LT-21700 battery ensures high discharge capacity and stable voltage under heavy acceleration. Dual controllers manage current flow efficiently, sustaining consistent torque and acceleration even during prolonged high-speed rides.

Frame and Engineering

The Thunder 3 uses a reinforced aviation-grade aluminum chassis, optimized for rigidity and vibration absorption. The integrated stem design enhances stability at high speeds, while the wide silicone-coated deck improves traction and comfort. Its 51 kg frame maintains a solid balance between durability and maneuverability.

Suspension and Ride Quality

Equipped with advanced 5-step adjustable suspension, the Thunder 3 adapts seamlessly to varied road conditions. The wide 11-inch tubeless tires increase grip and ride smoothness, providing precise control on both asphalt and rough surfaces.

Braking and Safety

Hydraulic brakes with 160 mm rotors ensure powerful, reliable stopping performance. Regenerative EBS complements mechanical braking, improving control and extending battery life. Integrated LED lighting, turn signals, and a rear warning lamp enhance rider visibility and road safety.

Display and Connectivity

The EY4 display delivers full-color data readouts for speed, range, voltage, and temperature. Bluetooth connectivity integrates with the Dualtron app, allowing customization of acceleration profiles, lighting, and diagnostic checks directly from a smartphone.

Charging and Maintenance

Dual charging ports support parallel fast charging with improved insulation and moisture protection. The modular design of the Thunder 3 allows straightforward maintenance, ensuring long-term dependability and ease of service access.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Thunder 3 2025 offers 10800W power, 100 km/h top speed, and 170 km range in a 51 kg package. With LG battery precision, hydraulic braking, EY4 control, and world-class build quality, it stands as the ultimate choice for high-performance electric mobility.

title: DUALTRON EAGLE 60V 24.5Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Eagle Limited 2025 60V 24.5Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Eagle Limited 2025 elevates everyday riding with a refined design and powerful dual-motor system. Built on a 60V platform and equipped with a 24.5Ah LG-MJ1-3500 lithium battery, it delivers efficient performance and extended durability. The scooter outputs a total of 3000W through its dual BLDC hub motors, achieving a top speed of 70 km/h (40 mph) while maintaining stable, controlled acceleration. Offering up to 80 km (50 mi) of range per charge, it is ideal for long commutes and adventure rides alike.

Battery and Powertrain

The 60V 24.5Ah battery provides 1.4 kWh of usable energy, offering reliable voltage stability under high loads. LG-MJ1 cells ensure long cycle life and consistent discharge efficiency. Together with the dual 1500W motors, the system produces responsive torque and smooth acceleration across varying terrains, maintaining strong performance during climbs and sustained high-speed travel.

Ride Comfort and Stability

The Dualtron Eagle Limited integrates a flexible suspension setup with rubber cartridges that can be adjusted or replaced to fine-tune the ride feel. The low deck profile enhances center of gravity, improving stability at high speeds and over rough pavement. It supports a maximum rider weight of 100 kg while preserving agile handling and balanced weight distribution.

Construction and Weight

Weighing just 30 kg, the Eagle Limited maintains a durable yet portable frame. The reinforced aluminum alloy chassis provides rigidity and resilience under daily use. Its folding mechanism allows compact storage and quick setup, making it practical for both home and urban riders who require mobility and transport convenience.

Braking and Safety

Equipped with dual mechanical disc brakes, the scooter ensures responsive, controlled stopping power. Regenerative braking supplements the mechanical system to extend battery life slightly while smoothing deceleration. This combination enhances rider confidence, particularly at higher speeds or on steep descents.

Controls and Interface

The EY3 display system provides live feedback on speed, battery level, voltage, and total mileage. Riders can access performance tuning through the interface, including acceleration modes and power settings. The display is compatible with the Dualtron App, allowing deeper system monitoring and configuration options.

Lighting and Visibility

The Eagle Limited includes a full LED lighting package, with bright front headlights and integrated rear brake lights. Side reflectors improve lateral visibility, enhancing safety during night rides. All lights are powered directly from the scooter’s main battery, ensuring consistent illumination without separate charging.

Weather Protection and Durability

Designed for year-round use, the scooter’s internal wiring and connectors are sealed for dust and splash resistance. The deck’s silicone grip coating improves traction and water resistance, reducing slippage during wet conditions. Component layout prioritizes reliability and service access for long-term usability.

Performance Summary

The Dualtron Eagle Limited 2025 combines a 3000W dual-motor setup, 70 km/h top speed, and 80 km range in a 30 kg frame. Its 60V 24.5Ah LG battery provides steady power delivery with strong torque, while adjustable suspension, dual brakes, and smart display controls ensure a comfortable, controlled ride for everyday urban and long-distance use.

title: DUALTRON SPIDER 2 60V 24Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Spider 2 2025 | 60V 24Ah

The Dualtron Spider 2 2025 is a lightweight performance scooter built for riders who demand power and precision in a portable design. It operates on a 60V system with a 24Ah CHINA 21700 battery, delivering long-lasting efficiency and stability. The dual hub motors generate a combined 3600W of power, reaching speeds up to 70 km/h (40 mph). With a maximum range of 80 km (50 mi) and a 90 kg load capacity, it offers the ideal balance of speed, endurance, and agility.

Power and Battery System

The 1.4 kWh lithium battery delivers consistent voltage output and efficient current delivery to both motors, ensuring smooth acceleration and reliable range performance. Dual motors provide strong torque and controlled traction, allowing confident climbing and quick starts.

Design and Build

Built from aerospace-grade aluminum alloy, the Spider 2 maintains strength while keeping its weight to just 26 kg. Its clean frame geometry enhances rigidity and balance, supported by a wider deck and compact folding system for portability. The minimalist black finish highlights Dualtron’s engineering focus on strength and simplicity.

Ride Quality and Suspension

Front and rear suspension systems combine with low-resistance rubber bushings to absorb road vibration, improving comfort and control on uneven terrain. The large 10-inch tires provide traction and stability, ideal for both urban roads and light off-road paths.

Braking and Safety

Hydraulic brakes on both wheels ensure reliable stopping power, paired with regenerative EBS for smoother deceleration and improved efficiency. Reflective accents and bright LEDs increase visibility in low-light conditions.

Technology and Controls

The EY3 display provides essential data including speed, battery level, and riding mode. Riders can fine-tune throttle response, braking behavior, and light settings directly from the screen, enhancing customization and ride control.

Portability and Maintenance

At 26 kg, the Spider 2 is easy to lift and store, featuring a foldable stem and compact handlebar design. The modular layout allows quick access to key components for service, ensuring long-term reliability with minimal upkeep.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Spider 2 2025 delivers 3600W of power, 70 km/h speed, and 80 km range in a sleek 26 kg frame. Lightweight, durable, and powerful, it’s built for riders seeking maximum efficiency without sacrificing performance.

title: DUALTRON NEW VICTOR LUXURY 60V 24Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Victor Luxury 2025 60V 24Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron Victor Luxury 2025 combines elegant design with powerful performance, elevating the proven Victor platform into a more refined and feature-rich electric scooter. Equipped with a 60V 24Ah battery and dual 4000W hub motors, it offers strong acceleration, excellent stability, and dependable range, making it ideal for riders seeking both power and sophistication.

Power and Performance

Dual 2000W BLDC hub motors deliver a total peak output of 4000W, propelling the Victor Luxury to speeds of up to 80 km/h. The 60V electrical system ensures smooth torque delivery and sustained power, allowing for quick acceleration and confident hill climbing. Designed for performance-oriented riders, it offers both thrilling speed and precise handling across city and suburban roads.

Battery and Range

Powered by a 60V 24Ah battery built with CHINA 21700 cells, the Victor Luxury achieves up to 70 km of range on a single charge. The 1.5 kWh capacity ensures efficient power output and consistent performance throughout the discharge cycle. Dual charging ports support faster recharging while the battery management system regulates temperature, current, and voltage for long-term safety.

EY3 Display and App Connectivity

The upgraded EY3 display provides clear real-time data on speed, range, and voltage. Bluetooth connectivity with the Minimotors App allows for remote access to scooter diagnostics, speed settings, and performance tuning. The intuitive layout offers easy control over regenerative braking, acceleration response, and security PIN settings.

Chassis and Build Quality

The Victor Luxury’s reinforced aluminum alloy frame delivers strength without unnecessary weight. At 33 kg, it maintains portability while supporting up to 100 kg of load. The deck features refined finishing, non-slip coating, and integrated side lighting, giving the scooter a clean and premium look that lives up to its name.

Suspension and Comfort

The adjustable front and rear cartridge suspension ensures smooth and controlled movement over rough or uneven terrain. Paired with 10-inch pneumatic tires, it provides balanced shock absorption, grip, and ride stability. The setup caters to both comfort-focused city rides and higher-speed performance sessions.

Braking and Safety

Hydraulic disc brakes on both wheels offer superior braking response and modulation. The system is complemented by regenerative braking, extending battery efficiency and reducing wear on brake pads. Combined with the scooter’s low center of gravity, the Victor Luxury provides reliable stopping power at any speed.

Lighting and Visibility

Bright front and rear LED lights improve visibility for night riding. The integrated deck lights enhance side visibility and aesthetics. All lighting elements are energy-efficient and weather-resistant, ensuring consistent operation in all conditions.

Design and Aesthetic Refinement

The Victor Luxury distinguishes itself with a sleek silhouette and polished details. The deck lighting, logo illumination, and upgraded finishes emphasize Dualtron’s focus on visual refinement. The folding system is compact yet rigid, combining elegance with everyday practicality.

Handling and Control

Its wide handlebars, balanced geometry, and responsive throttle deliver excellent control even at higher speeds. The Victor Luxury’s tuned steering setup provides smooth cornering and directional stability, while its compact dimensions make it equally suitable for dense urban environments.

Durability and Maintenance

Internal wiring is neatly routed and protected for long-term reliability. The mechanical layout allows easy access for servicing components such as brakes, tires, or suspension. Built to withstand everyday use, the Victor Luxury maintains Dualtron’s reputation for engineering precision and endurance.

In the Box

Includes standard charger, power cable, nut caps, user manual, and tool kit. Optional accessories such as fast charger, seat kit, and extended deck mat are available separately.

Conclusion

The Dualtron Victor Luxury 2025 60V 24Ah brings the perfect mix of style, power, and practicality. With its dual 4000W motors, advanced EY3 display, hydraulic brakes, and refined design, it delivers premium performance in a compact frame. Whether commuting or cruising at speed, the Victor Luxury 2025 stands out as a true blend of comfort, technology, and Dualtron craftsmanship.

title: DUALTRON ULTRA 2 UPGRADE 72V 32Ah
body_html:
Dualtron Ultra 2 Upgrade 2025 | 72V 32Ah | 6640W

The Dualtron Ultra 2 Upgrade 2025 is built for extreme performance and endurance, combining a 72V 32Ah battery using CHINA 21700 cells with dual hub motors producing 6640W peak output. This powerful configuration delivers up to 95 km/h top speed and a maximum range of 90 km on a single charge, allowing riders to push further with confidence. Despite its raw power, it weighs only 45 kg while supporting riders up to 100 kg, striking the ideal balance between stability, strength, and agility.

Smart Widescreen Display and Control

At the center of its cockpit is the new wide-format EY4 display, offering crystal-clear visibility of speed, battery level, temperature, and trip data. Its expanded interface allows riders to monitor and adjust performance settings in real time. The upgraded controls give smoother throttle response and precise handling, supported by a 72V system that maintains consistent current flow even under heavy load.

Enhanced Lighting and Safety System

The sound and lighting package has been re-engineered for maximum visibility and rider awareness. Dual 30W headlights cut through darkness with ease, while a 320W rear taillight, turn signals, and an electronic horn keep the rider visible and audible to surrounding traffic. Integrated deck lights and side reflectors enhance low-light safety, completing a setup designed for night rides and off-road exploration.

Refined Structure and Frame Upgrades

Minimotors has reinforced the Ultra 2 Upgrade with a thicker folding clamp and wider stem joint, increasing the clamp’s surface area by 2 cm for greater rigidity and stability. The new folding mechanism locks more securely, eliminating steering wobble during acceleration or braking. Combined with a widened handlebar now 685 mm across, up from 600 mm it provides better leverage, smoother turns, and improved control at top speeds.

Ride Quality and Suspension System

Built for versatility, the scooter features front and rear adjustable suspension systems that absorb terrain shocks with ease. Its 11-inch ultra-wide off-road tires provide outstanding traction across dirt, gravel, and asphalt surfaces. Whether carving through forest trails or cruising city streets, the Ultra 2 Upgrade maintains balance and comfort across every terrain type.

Engineering and Durability

The chassis is crafted from high-strength aluminum alloy, designed to withstand long-term use while minimizing weight. The 2.3 kWh battery ensures stable voltage and sustained torque delivery, making the scooter capable of steep climbs up to 35°. The powertrain’s square-wave controller optimizes acceleration, maintaining smooth power output even at high speeds.

Design and Functionality

Practical engineering defines every aspect of the Ultra 2 Upgrade from its modular frame for easier maintenance to its improved cooling system that enhances motor efficiency. The high ground clearance and reinforced deck structure allow it to tackle rough trails without scraping. title: DUALTRON NEW CITY 60V 20Ah
body_html:
Dualtron City 2024 60V 20Ah Dual Motor

The Dualtron City 2024 offers a refined balance of power, comfort, and endurance. Running on a 60V 20Ah battery composed of reliable China 21700 lithium cells, it produces a total of 4000W through its dual hub motor system. This setup pushes the scooter to speeds up to 70 km/h (40 mph) while delivering a range of approximately 90 km (50 mi). Designed to support riders up to 100 kg, it maintains structural strength within a manageable 41 kg frame, combining stability and mobility for daily commutes or extended urban rides.

Power and Performance

At the heart of the Dualtron City is its dual 2000W hub motors, engineered for efficient power distribution and smooth acceleration. The 60V system ensures optimal torque, making it capable of climbing moderate inclines without strain. The combined 4000W output gives rapid throttle response while maintaining consistent top-end speed for longer distances, making it ideal for both city navigation and open-road cruising.

Battery and Range

The 20Ah battery configuration, rated at 1.2 kWh, uses China 21700 cells for stable discharge and energy density. This efficient power storage supports up to 90 km of travel per charge, depending on terrain, speed, and load. Integrated with a smart BMS, it protects against overcharging and temperature fluctuations, ensuring long-term battery reliability. Dual charging ports allow faster recharging cycles, minimizing downtime between rides.

Design and Frame

Built around a reinforced aluminum chassis, the Dualtron City maintains structural rigidity under high stress while keeping overall weight at 41 kg. Its layout accommodates the large 60V battery while keeping a low center of gravity for enhanced control. The wide deck provides ample standing space, and the folding handlebar system simplifies storage and transport when not in use.

Ride Comfort and Suspension

The City’s suspension system is tuned for urban and mixed-surface riding. Dual spring cartridges absorb shocks from uneven ground while maintaining rider stability at higher speeds. Paired with its wide pneumatic tires, this setup ensures a smoother, quieter ride and improved handling on variable terrain.

Braking and Safety

Equipped with front and rear hydraulic disc brakes, the scooter provides responsive stopping power with precise modulation. The dual braking system distributes braking force evenly to maintain balance during sudden stops. Combined with regenerative braking, it enhances both safety and battery efficiency during deceleration.

Lighting and Visibility

Integrated LED headlight and rear light assemblies provide strong illumination for night rides. Side-mounted reflectors and indicator lights increase visibility in traffic. These components are designed for minimal energy draw while maintaining brightness, contributing to overall safety and compliance with road visibility standards.

Handling and Control

With its balanced geometry and responsive steering, the Dualtron City handles predictably at all speeds. The scooter’s wide wheelbase and low deck height provide stability, while its electronic throttle system ensures smooth acceleration and regenerative control. The grip and suspension design allow confident maneuvering through corners or rough streets.

Durability and Usability

The Dualtron City’s frame and electrical systems are weather-resistant, ensuring consistent performance in light rain and urban dust conditions. The scooter supports a maximum load of 100 kg, making it adaptable to a variety of riders. Key components such as tires, suspension cartridges, and brake pads are serviceable and easily replaceable.

Experience and Practicality

Despite its 41 kg weight, the City’s folding mechanism and balanced structure make it practical for transport and storage. The ergonomic handlebar and solid foot deck design improve ride comfort during longer commutes. It’s engineered for reliability, blending long range with manageable weight and advanced braking performance.

Conclusion

The Dualtron City 2024 60V 20Ah stands as a dependable dual-motor electric scooter for riders seeking high performance and endurance. With 4000W of total motor power, a 90 km range, 70 km/h top speed, and strong suspension dynamics, it delivers a professional-grade ride built for both comfort and thrill—ideal for riders who demand capability, control, and proven Dualtron reliability.

title: DUALTRON X LIMITED 84V 60Ah
body_html:
Dualtron X LTD 2025 | 84V 60Ah | 13440W Dual Motor

The Dualtron X LTD 2025 stands as the most powerful and advanced scooter in Minimotors’ lineup. Equipped with dual hub motors delivering a combined 13,440W of peak power and an 84V 60Ah LG-M50LT-21700 battery, it redefines high-performance electric mobility. Capable of reaching speeds up to 110 km/h with a range of 170 km, it surpasses the Dualtron X2 UP and Storm Limited, setting a new benchmark in torque, endurance, and engineering excellence.

Battery and Power System

The X LTD’s colossal 5.0 kWh battery delivers immense current flow for continuous high-output riding. It maintains strong acceleration and torque under sustained load while optimizing thermal management through advanced BMS protection. This system prevents overcurrent, overcharge, and voltage imbalance, ensuring battery longevity and stable output even at peak speeds.

Display and Connectivity

At its core, the scooter features the EY4 color LCD display with Bluetooth connectivity. The waterproof unit offers a vibrant interface showing speed, voltage, temperature, and performance metrics in real time. Paired with the Minimotors app, riders can fine-tune throttle sensitivity, braking response, lighting modes, and regenerative braking levels. The integrated PIN lock function enhances security against unauthorized use.

Lighting and Visibility

The 100W headlight system provides unmatched night visibility with dual high-intensity beams and adjustable angles. Complementary side RGB lighting, deck LEDs, and rear signals improve overall visibility, turning the X LTD into a beacon even in complete darkness. Every light module is controlled through the central DC converter, allowing unified brightness and mode management.

Performance and Ride Quality

Each motor operates through independent high-current controllers for precise power delivery. This setup ensures instant torque with seamless transitions at high speeds, enabling stable launches and high-efficiency cruising. The scooter’s acceleration curve has been recalibrated for smoother throttle modulation and higher sustained top-end performance, offering a driving experience close to a lightweight electric motorcycle.

Suspension and Handling

Featuring a next-generation damping system with adjustable spring cartridges, the X LTD delivers unparalleled comfort and traction. The rear suspension uses a vertically mounted high-capacity shock absorber for increased travel and impact absorption. The wide 13-inch ultra-grip tires enhance stability and reduce rolling resistance, maintaining control on varied terrains at any speed.

Braking and Safety

Braking is managed by hydraulic 4-piston calipers on ventilated discs, providing consistent stopping power and heat dissipation even under continuous braking. The system integrates with electronic ABS and regenerative braking, ensuring full control during deceleration while feeding energy back to the battery. Combined with a 150 kg load capacity, it ensures predictable and secure handling at all times.

Frame and Design

The Dualtron X LTD’s reinforced aviation-grade aluminum frame provides exceptional rigidity with an 83 kg overall mass, supporting both high-speed stability and rider comfort. The wide 13-inch wheelbase offers improved grip, while the raised deck height enhances ground clearance for off-road performance. Cable management and thermal routing have been optimized for long-term durability and easier maintenance.

Technology and Upgrades

This 2025 iteration introduces the new EY4 user interface, improved waterproofing, and increased motor efficiency via upgraded windings. The suspension geometry has been refined for reduced steering vibration, while the upgraded battery connector system allows dual fast charging for reduced downtime. The scooter also includes a reinforced stem joint and modular frame structure for easy part replacements.

Comfort and Ergonomics

The spacious deck and wide handlebars give riders stable posture and precise control. Dual charging ports and an intelligent voltage display simplify energy management. Its 82.9 kg chassis balances extreme performance with manageable handling, making it suitable for both road and trail use.

Conclusion

The Dualtron X LTD 2025 is the apex of the Dualtron engineering line delivering 13,440W power, 110 km/h top speed, and a massive 170 km range. With its 84V 60Ah LG battery, EY4 smart system, four-piston hydraulic brakes, advanced suspension, and 150 kg load capacity, it is built for riders who demand the most powerful, durable, and technologically advanced electric scooter ever produced.
